rnam pa mdor bstan/na/ shes pa sgom pa'i lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sa la 'gom pa'i gang zag dngos po 'gom pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i mig 'o na/ khyod rang la de chos can/ stong nyid kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes ma yin par thal lo/ /stong nyid sgom pa'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na dngos su 'gal lo/ /khyab cing / 'dod mi nus te/ stong nyid kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pa'i shes pa yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de rnam mkhyen gyi bh+yor ba yin tshul gcig med par thal/rnam mkhyen thob phyir du de dang rjes mthun gyi lam sgom pa de rnam mkhyen sgom pa'i don ma yin pa'i pyir/ der thal/ des rnam mkhyen sgom na rnam mkhyen gyi yul mi sgom par yul can kho na sgom par khyod kyis 'dod pa de'i phyid gzhan yang lam de'i bsgom bya yin na/ lam de'i 'odzin ltangs kyi yul du byas pas khyab par thal/ khyed cag gis don rnam dang shes rnam gang rung re kho na bsgom byar 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sgom tshul la gser 'phreng ltar 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas sgom pa gcig dang / yul can de'i ngo 'or bskyed nas sgom pa gcig dang / rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pas sgom pa gcig dang / de'i rtogs rigs kyis sgom pa dang] mtshan nyid rjes su dpyod pa'i rnam pas sgom pa dang / smon lam gyi rnam pas sgom pa dang drug sogs yod pa'i pyid dang po grub ste/ bdag med dang bden bzhi'i khyad chos sgom pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ byams pa dang snying rje sgom pa la sgom byed blo de'i bdag nyid du byas nas sgom pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub lte/ tshogs lam na dad sogs dbang ṭo lnga stobs lnga med kyang de rjes su mthun pa yod pa sgom pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa grub lte/ mkhyen gsum ma thob gong du byang sems kyis de sgom pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/lnga pa grub ste/ tshogs lam du rgyar lam dang mthong sgom sogs kyi mtshan nyid dpyad nas sgom 17
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa grub ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gsang gsum 'grub pa'i dmigs pa byas nas thob gdod kyi smon pa skyed pa lta bu yin pa'i pyir/ dper na/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mthu (1)ma thob pas sems bskyed pa lta bu/ dkon mchog ta la las/ gang dag mos pa'i khyad par rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba kun gyis rtag byin brlabs/ /gang dag rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /de dag byang chub don du sems kyang bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs pa'i ye shes de skabs 'dir bstan pa'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid zer na/rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig der thal/ skabs 'dir dngos shugs gang rung la bstan pa'i gnyen 4 yin pa'i pyid 'dod na/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs yod par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ rang gi gzhom bya med pa'i phyir te/ mthar thug gi skyabs yin pa'i phyir/ phung 4 mi rtag par rtogs pa'i ye shes chos can/ khyod rang gi mi mthun phyogs phung 4 bden 'dzin dang danags pa gcig la dmigs nas 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs par thal/ khyod rang gi mi mthun phyongags phung po bden 'dzin gyi gnyen po yin pa'i pyid khyab pa khas/rtags grub ste/ de la brgyud nas gnod byed yin pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel las/ mi rtag las ni hā/ (rdzu lja dī /'i /:lha/ ༷r+shasna pa m+p+raṃ shā/ga snya shālha ñcā / dā smi ṭ+wāṃ /lha zloX rnyi shā~X rdzu(spru shes dang] bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes re re nas chos can/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs chags pa dang der thal/ de'i phyig rtags sla/ 'dod na/ chags pa bdag 'dzin gnyis ka dang sgrib gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /de'i rigs pas dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas rang gi — —wa wa—— ———wawa1 b.razengasaganyisapa/byangasams kyi marumathongabs/18
rnam pa mdor bstan/mi mthun phyogs dang 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs pa de/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs de'i dngos kyi gnyen po'i mtshan nyid zer na'ang sgom lam bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs chags pa dang der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ de'i dngos kyi spang bya chags snang yod pa'i phyig gdod na sngar ltar ro/ /yang kha cig /lam ma zhugs na gnyen 4 med zer na/ chags pa'i gnyen 4 yin na de spong byed kyi gnyen po yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mdzod las/ gnyen 4 rnam bzhi spong ba dang / /gzhi dang bsring nyid rnam par ni/ /sun 'byin zhes sga zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi spong gnyen dang / gzhi gnyen dang / thag bsring gnyen po dang / rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po bzhi med par thal/ chags pa'i gnyen 4 la spong gnyen gcig sus khyab pa'i migrtags khas/ khyab ste/ spong gnyen la bar chad med lam gyis khyab pa'i phyir/ rang 'grel las/spong ba'i gnyen po ni bar chad med pa'i lam thams cad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de bzhi yod pa'i pyid der thal/ spong gnyen yang yod/ gzhi gnyen yang yod/ thag bsring gnyen po yang yod/ rnam par sun 'byin gnyen bo yang yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/bar chad med lam rnams rkun 4 'byin mkhan lta bu spong gnyen de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam grol lam thams cad sgo gcod mkhan lta bu gzhi'i gnyen 4 yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ gzhi'i gnyen 4 ni rnam par grol pa'i lam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gsum pa grub ste/ rnam grol lam yan chad kyi lam dang khyad par gyi lam rnams nyon mongs thag bsring ba'i gnyen 4 yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ thag bsring ba'i ngo bo'i gnyen 4 ni khyad par gyi lam mo zhes bya ba 'di ni ches legs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / ches legs pa smos pa ni bye smra'i 'dod pa las zur du slob dpon rang gi 'dod pa legs par bshad 19
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/pa'o/ /bzhi pa grub ste/ lam gang gis nyon mongs de'i skyon mthong nas sun 'byin pa de yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen pho ni lam gang gis khams de la skyon du mthong nas rnam par sun 'byon par byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid gzhan yangakamdzod las/ mtshan nyid mi mthun mi mthun phyogs/ /yul rnams chad dang dus kyis te/ /'byung dang tshul khrims phyogs dang ni/ /dus gnyis ring ba nyid lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid mi mthun pas ring ba 'byung bzhi lta bu dang/ gnyen pos ring ba tshul khrims dang tshul 'chal lta bu dang / yul gyi ring ba shar nub kyi mtha' gnyis lta bu/ dus kyi ring ba 'das ma 'ong lta bu ring ba bzhi mi 'thad par thal/ gnyen pos ring ba de med pa'i pyid der thal/ tshul khrims tshul 'chal gyi gnyen po ma yin pa'i phyir/ lam ma zhugs na gnyen po med pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang /rnam bshad las/ theg pa chen po'i dbang po phyiston pos byang chub kyi mtshog tu sems bskyed pa'i snga rol tu stong nyid rtogs pa 'gro dgos pa'i phyig zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ lam ma zhugs na stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i pyir/ der thal/ lam ma zhugs na gnyen 4 med pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dbu ma rgyan las/ yang dag shes 'tshol sngon btang ste/ /don dam rnam par nges gyur nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sngon gyi don gcig med par thal/ snying rje chen po'i sngon du'ang zeg chen rigs nges dbang non gyis stong nyid rtogs dgos par bstan pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ lam ma zhugs na de med pa'i phyid gzhan yang / rtsabad sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang / /nas/ chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du/ /shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don gcig med par thal/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang po rno rtul gnyis ka dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas pa de'i don ma yin pa'i phyig ma khyab na khyab par thal/ de gnyis de lnga la mkhas pa tsam du mtshungs pa'i phyis rnam bshad las/ rgyan gyi 20
rnam pa mdor bstan/gdul bya gnyis ka dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas par mtshungs pa de lta mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub lte/ lam ma zhugs na mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu gagasum zos bsam gyis nges par byas pa'i rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya gnyis med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lam ma zhugs nas de gnyis kyis de ltar byas nas sgom pas rnam pa brgya don gsum la myong ba thon pa dang theg chen lam du zhugs pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/lam ma zhugs na rnam pa brgya dang don gsum rtogs pa med pa'i phyir te/ de na gnyen 4 med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas so/ /de sogs spro sla'o/ /yang kha cig /rnam pa brgya don gsum skabs kyi mdo las don rnam 'ba' zhig bstan zer/ kha cig /rab 'gyor gyis shes rnam dang de bzhin gshegs pas don rnam bstan zer/ la la de las ldog nas bstan zer ba gsum ga mi 'thad par thal/ rab 'byor dang de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis nas don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis ka dngos shugs ci rigs la bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dper na rnam pa dang po la rab 'byor gyis ma mchis pa zhes pas don rnam dang / pha rol tu phyin pas shes rnam gnyis sgras zin la bstan pa gang zhig /de bzhin gshegs pas nam mkha' med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pas rtag par med pa'i don rnam dngos dang shes rnam shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ gser phreng las/ rab 'byor dang de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis nas don rnam dang shes rnam ci rigs par gsungs te/ dper na ma mchis pas don rnam dang / de'i phar phyin gyis shes rnam gnyis sgras zin par bstan la/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ nam mkha' med pa'i phyir/ zhes pas dngos su rtag par med pa'i don rnam dang shugs la de med par rtogs pa'i shes rnam bltan pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggnyis pa rang lugs la/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas rang 21
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/gi mi mthun phyogs la gnod byed kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i rig pa de/ gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ cha bzhag smos pas 'dzin stangs mi gsal ba'i 'gog pa'i rnam thar lta bu dang mos sgom kha cig r+shar+sha k+ṣiṃ /khyespya snaX /sra /nye/ na/a+thi+-i dzo/ hūm̐ gh+nā lha( ༈ rdzu pa〉〉 /la tshi sno sbri spra/ gh+nā spra// rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi rnam pa shar nas rang gi mi mthun phyogs la gnod byed kyi rig pa de/ skabs 'der bstan gyi gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na lam zhugs dang lam ma zhugs kyi de gnyis dang] theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs kyi gnyen po shes rnam gsum 'dad/ gzhung gis bstan tshul 8(da de/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /zhes pas shes rnam de bstan/ rnam pa zhes pas gnyen po'i mtshan nyid bstan/ mtshan nyid ces pas phyi ma snga ma'i lasdog byed du tshig gis bstan pa'i phyig dang 4 grub lte/ nyi snang las/ dngos 4 la dmigs pa ni gzhi shes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ bye brag gi skad dod tra shi dzi'i bi rnam pa'i skad dod yin pa'i phyir/ nyi snang las/ bye brag ni mi mthun phyogs gang gi gnyen po'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ khyab ste/ rnam bshad las/ mkhyen pa gsum 4 gang rung gi rnam pa legs par shar nas sgom par byed pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes zhes bya ba ni skabs 'dir gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na/ rnam pa zhes sga zhes pa'i rnam pa la du ma yod de/ phung yo mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i don rnam brgya bdun cu rtsagasum dang / phung po mi rtag par rtogs pa'i gzhi shes sogs mkhyen gsum gyi shes rnam brgya dang don gsum dang /mkhyen gsum gyi 'odzin snyangs brgya don gsum 'odzin stangs su byed pa'i byang sems kyi sbyongar ba'i shes rnam brgya dang don gsum la rnam par byas pa ste gsum gyis bshad dgos pa'i phyir te/ mdo las bshad tshul de'i phyis22
rnam pa mdor bstan/gsum pa rtsod spong la kho na re/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi 'odzin stangs kyi rnam pa shar bar thal/ gnyen 4 yin pa'i mig gdod na/ rang yul gyi rnam pa shar bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de'i yul la dmigs yul dngos yul shugs yul gsum yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de'i dngos yul la gang zag gi bdag med phra mos khyab pa'i phyig des lhag ma kun shes sla/ yang kha cig /'grel chung skabs 'di'i tshig la don rnam shes rnam gyi tha snyad med pas/ lo chenadang rje yab sras sogs kyis don rnam dang shes rnam zer ba gsung rab kyi tha snyad min zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ don rnam gyi tha snyad gsung rab las bshad pa gang zhig /shes rnam la yang de'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rtsabaka 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /rnam pa/ zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/ yul rnam can ni tha dad pas/ /blo yi rtogs pa tha dad phyir/ /zhes pa lta bu grangs kyis mi langs pa'i pyir/ gnyis pa grub lte/ rigs 'byin gyis/ ye shes kyi rnam pa ni gnyen po ma lus pa la dmigs par byed pa'i sems rmya khyad par ro/ /zhes mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa zhes yang yang du mas bshad pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/rgyas bshad kyis kyang shes rnam gtso 'or dngos su bstan par thal/ mdor bstan gyis shes rnam dngos bstan gyi gtso bor byas pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ mdor bstan gyis de ltar yin pa gang zhig/rgyas bshad kyis dngos bstan don rnam gtso 'or bshad pa'i phyig dang 4 grub lte/ gser 'phreng las/ 'der bstan pa'i tshul ni mdor bstan du shes pa'i rnam pa dang] rgyas bshad du don gyi rnam pa gtso sor bstan te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabad bden pa so so la bzhi dngan /lam la de ni bco lngar bshad/ /ces dang/ nyi snang las/ bden pa gang la rnam pa ji snyed yod pa de ston pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gser 'phreng ltar bshad do/ /yang kho na re/ bden med rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa can gyi kyor ba chos can/ bden med rtogs 23

phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi shes kyi ngo sor gyur pa'i shes rnam nyi shu gabadun skabs 'dir dngos su ma bstan na rnam rdzogs bh+yor ba'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ma lus pa skabs gzhan du yang dngos su ma bstan par khas len dgos pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ sgrib pa gang zhig /thar pa thob pa la bar du gcod byed nyon sgrib kyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig /thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la bar du gcod byed de shes sgrib kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin chos can/ shes sgrib yin par thal/ thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la bar du gcod byed yin pa'i phyis der thal/ thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la de bcom pa sngon du 'gro dgos kyi sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ma spangs par thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa med pa'i pyig yang kha cig na re/ bden 'dzin chos can nyon sgrib yin par thal thar pa thob pa la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byang sems rigs nges kyis thar pa thob pa la bden 'dzin nges par slong dgos pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ des thar pa 4ba pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ kun btus las/ des byang chub thob pa na nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa cig car spong ngo / /cig car dgra bcom pa dang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'o na bden 'dzin chos can/khyod mngon gyur du rgyud la ldan pa'i dgra bcom pa med par thal/ khyod thar pa thob pa la bar du gcod byed yin pa'i phyig ma khyab na/ chos thams cad kyis kyang thar pa la bar du gcod par thal lo/ /yang kha cig na re/ shes sgrib de byang sems tshogs lam pas byang sems kyi sgom lam thob pa la bar du gcod byed kyi sgrib pa yin par thal/ de byang sems tshogs lam pas rnam mkhyen thob pa la bar du gcod byed gang zhig /rnam mkhyen thob pa la zeg chen gyi sgom lam thob pa sngon du 'akro dgos pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ shes sgrib tsam sangs ma rgyas bar du spangs mi 32
gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bzhud/thub kyang mthong sgom gyi lam rnams thob tshog pa'i gyid byas pa la kho na re/ des sgom lam thob pa la bar du gcod par thal/ des sgom lam thob pa la gnod pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ gnod pa tsam gyis bar du gcod pa dang gegs byed pas ma khyab pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ sgrib pa yin na nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ 'o na sgrib pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyig 'dod na/ shes sgrib yin par thal/ de gnyis gang rung gang zhig nyon sgrib ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang so dngos/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i gang zag yin na khyod spangs pas khyab par thal/ khyod nyon sgrib yin pa'i phyid 'dod na/ nyan zos dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ khyod la shes sgrib kyis khyab par thal lo/ /byas pa la kho na re/ rdzas sbyo chod pa'i dbang du byas zer na/ 'o na sgrib pa la nyon sgrib shes sgrib snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gsum med par thal lo/ /dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de gsum du dbye ba de stobs bcu la dngos brgyud ci rigs pas sgrib tshul sgo nas gsum byas pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma las/ stobs sdudags rnams las stobs drug dang / /gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ /shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang / /bag chags bcas pa kun bsal bas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i dang /khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i dang / mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i dang / kun nyon dang rnam byang mkhyen pa'i dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs drug gis shes sgrib kyi go cha lta bu lasdoms pas thob pa gang zhig /bsam gtan dang rnam thar mkhyen pa'i dang / sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i dang / 'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs gsum gyis snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa jig pa lta bu 'joms pa dang / zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis nyon sgrib shing lta bu 'joms pa'i phyir/ dang po grub lte/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka las/ gnas dang gnas min/ zhes pa 33
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/nas/ thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa drug gis/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa'i go cha shes sgrib 'bigs par phyed pa la rdo rje lta bu dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub nye/ rgyud bla ma'i dar ṭīka las/ bsam gtan dang] nas/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgrib pa rtsig pa brtan 4 gzhig pa la rdo rje lta bu dang /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gsum pa grub lte/ de nyid las/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs gang yin pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i shing rnams gcod pa'i phyir rdo rje bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid byas pa la kho na re/ de shes sgrib yin zer/ la la na re/ nyon sgrib zer na/ de gnyis ka mi 'thad par thal/ shes sgrib ma yin pa gang zhig /nyon sgrib ma yin pa'i phyig dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod spangs pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa med par thal/ khyod shes sgrib yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ gnyis lnga'i cha las grol pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ 'gog 4ba gnyis ka las rnam grol/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyoggnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi dgra bcom med par thal/ khyod nyon sgrib yin pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las ma grol pa'i dgra bcom pa'am/dgra bcom rgyan med yod pa'i pyig de sgrib pa yin byas pa la kho na re/ las sgrib sgrib pa yin par thal/ de sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ de gnyis sgrib pa yin min mtshungs par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyis 'dod na/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa yin na sgrib pa ma yin pas khyab par thal/ las sgrib la de'i pyid gangor gsum/ 'dod na/ der gyur pa'i bying rgod gnyis chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyis khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ gnyis med las su rung ba'i phyig /rtsub pa'i reg dang bral ba yin/ /zhes dang / de'i dar ṭika las/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pas bsdus pa'i bying rgod gnyis med pas ting nge 7rin sgom pa las su rung ba'i 34
gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshad/phyig zhes gsungs pa'i pyid byas pa la kho na re/ de chos can/ sgrib gnyis gang rung yin par thal/ sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ khyab par thal/ sgrib pa la sgrib pa gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir na yang ma khyab/ rtags grub lte/ thar pa thob pa'i gegs byed nyon sgrib dang / shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i gegs byed shes sgrib gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ dbus mtha' las/ nyon mongs pa yi sgrib pa dang / /shes bya yi ni sgrib pa nye/ /der ni sgrib pa thams cad bstan/ /de zad pas na grol bar 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyogyang kha cig /sgrib pa la nyon sgrib shes sgrib gnyis su ma nges par thal/ gsum du nges pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub zin/ 'dod mi nus te/ sgrib pa thams cad de gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir te/ dbus mtha' las/ der ni sgrib pa thams cad bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thams zlo/ spras / byi ṭ+wāṃ dwo spridī/ pahāX spra/ baspra pa sna /paspri rnyiwa kyi tsho shā〉〉 k+ṣiṃ spra dri dī spran rnyi /pa thams cad kyi don bsdus pa ste/ sgrib pa chen po ni khyab pa gang yin pa'o/ /nas/ de khyad par du 'gro ba la sgrib pa ni sa rnams la sgrib pa gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dgongs 'grel las/ kun tu slongs pa ni du mchis/ gnas ngan len mi mthun phyogs ni du mchis/ zhes pa'i lan sma dgongs 'grel las/ kun tu rmongs pa ni nyi shu rtsaganyis dang /gnas ngan len mi mthun phyogs bcu gcig lte/ zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal sa bcu pa rgyun mtha'i ngos skal gyi slongs pa gnyis gnyis lte nyer gnyis dang / gnas ngan len re re byas pas bcu gcig yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sa bcu'i mi mthun phyogs gnas ngan len bcu gcig chos can/ sgrib gnyis gang rung yin par thal/ sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa khas/ rtags grub lte/ dbus mtha' las/ der ni sgrib pa thams cad bstan/ /zhes pa'i 35
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ dge ba bla na med pa la sgrib pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la sgrib pa gang yin pa'o/ /de khyad par du 'phro ba la sgrib pa ni sa rnams la sgrib pa gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des sgrib pa 'jog tshul du ma dgos par dbu ma'i mtha' )rdo snra ༷dī mtsho 93 sna bzlo r+sha rdo/ k+ṣiṃ/ dh+ri /sna nā shā/ngasnyi ༈ rlormi gā kau snroshā dī hūm̐/ nyon mongs kyi las byed par thal/ nyon sgrib yin pa'i mig rtags sla/ 'dod mi nus te/ des sems rgyud nyon mongs spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa ltar zhi bar byed kyi ma zhi bar mi byed pa'i phyir te/ 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams skyed la phan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ kun btus las/ sa bcu rnams su bsgom pa'i lam shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen yo slom lam gyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po ni ma yin te/ nas/ des nyon mongs ma spangs su zin yang sngags dang sman gyis bsad pa'i dug lta bu dang / dper na/ de spangs pa'i dgra brtsom pa ltar sa thams cad du nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi skyed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid rgyud bla ma'i dar ṭīka las/ srid pa'i zag pa mngon gyur yod kyang sngags dang sman gyis bsad pa'i dug lta bu nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi skyed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid 'di yang byang sems sgom lam pa la yin gyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed ma thag nas rung bar bshad na mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin la/ 'od dag gis mi spangs pa'i nyon mongs btags pa ba kho nar bshad pa dag gis phar phyin gyi skabs thams cad so skye dang nyan thos ltar bshad pas sgro skur gyi mthar lhung ngo / /zhes shes par bya'o/ /yang kha cig na re/de la gnyis kho nar ma nges par thal/ chags sgrib dang zogs sgrib gnyis kyang sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ de gnyis shes sgrib kyi rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/36
gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshad/sems can gyi khams ji lta ba ma lus pa la rmongs pas chags sgrib dang / ji snyed pa ma lus pa la slongs pas 'ogs sgrib tu lasdog pa'i pyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ dri med dbyings la chags med dang / /'ogs med phyir na dag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ de gnyis kyi ldog zla chags thogs med par mkhyen tshul de'i phyir/ de'i thogs 'grel las/ de la ji lta ba bzhin 'dzid pa nyid kyis sems can gyi khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i yul can gyi phyir na chags pa med pa yin la/ ji snyed pa yod pa nyid kyis shes bya'i dngos po mtha' med pa'i yul can gyi phyir na thogs pa med pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisyang kha cig /de la gnyis su grangs ma nges par thal/ 'dod chen pa'i sgrib pa dang / mu sprapa ༵ m+p+raṃ ༵ sbyispri spra'i ca/ rnyisna ṭ+wāṃ dzā/ k+ṣiṃ ༵ k+ham̐ sdi rnyi/ /rdzu pazhiX pa ṭ+wāṃ ༵ hūm̐ /sna n+d+ra snro rnyi sbri (/ ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ de bzhi'i dang 4 gnyis srid mthar ltang byed kyi sgrib pa dang / phyi ma gnyis zhi mthar lhung byed kyi sgrib pa'i ldog cha dang rten gang zag gi sgo nas phye ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ rigs chad 'dod chen pa chos la mi dga' ba dang / mu stegs pa'i bdag lta dang / nyan thos kyi la)gas sred dang / rang rgyal gyi rang don kho nar sred pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla pasna r+yaṃ/ hūm̐ sna ༵ dz+nyo shā bdakyu sbyishā /mu/ (sdu shā k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ la dzī r+nghi papa ṭ+wāṃ rnyi/ sgri/spra (sdu bzhi/ /zhes dngad dar ṭīka las/rten gyi sgo nas so sor phye ba yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigkhyab ste/ thogs 'grel las/ 'dod chen pa dang / pu stegs pa dang / nyan zos dang / rang sangs rgyas te/ de dag la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams mi rtogs pa dngad mngon sum du byed par mi 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa 'di bzhi yang dag par gnas 〈sna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ de 37
phar phyinagakhas bzhi pa/dag srid zhi'i mthar 'ching byed kyi sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dar ṭīka las/ theg pa chen po'i lam du bzod par byed pa kun gyis 'di dag spang bar bya ba yin la/ de yang srid pa'i mthar ltang ba dang / zhi ba'i mthar lhung ba dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ de'i phyi ma gnyis lam kho na yin zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod chen pa'i theg chen chos la snang rnyi spyangargya]rdzu ñcha shāspya bsna spra ṭ+wāṃ ṅgi/sa kāX n+dha sdi rnyi rnyipa pa m+p+raṃ dz+nyo k+ṣiṃ ñcha 〉( la/ (dī shārnyi sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na de bzhi'i gnyen pho phar phyin bzhi dang / 'bras bur yang gtsang ba dang / bdag dang / bde ba dang / rtag pa dam pa'i phar phyin bzhi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ dang po'i gnyen sor theg chen la mos pa ste/ yid ches kyi dad pa dang / gnyis pa'i gnyen por sher phyin dang / gsum pa'i gnyen por nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'odzin dngad bzhi pa'i gnyen por lhag bsam gyi snying rje yin pa de'i phyig zur dang 4 grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ zeg mchog la mos sa pon/ zhes dang / dar ṭīka las/ 'dir bstan pa'i mos pa ni zeg pa chen po'i chos rgyu 'bras la dang pa'i dad pa dang / 'dod pa'i dad pa dang / yid ches pa'i dad pa gsum las sgyi ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid gnyis pa grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos bskyed ma dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig bzhi pa grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ snying rje'i ma ma can/ /zhes dang / dar ṭīka las/ sgrib pa re dang gnyen po re sbyar te bshad pa/ zhes dang / 'ogs 'grel las/ gang gis gnyen por resnas pa la drenags pa'i chos 'di bzhi bsgom nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi ga so sor sbyar kyang mang dogs nas ma bris la/ dbus mtha'i 'grel pa las kyang / dge ba bla na med pa la sgrib pa ni pha rol 38
gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshad/tu phyin pa rnams la sgrib pa gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal la phar phyin med par bshad pas kyang shes par bya'o/ /②rtags gnyis pa grub lte/ rgyud bla ma las/ gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras/ /zhes dang / thogs 'grel las/ gang gi gnyen sor de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos skya sku'i yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bzhi rnam par bzhag ste/ 'di lta ste/ rtag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang/ bde ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bdag gi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gtsang ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ rjodakag nyan rang gi de sgrib pa ma yin par thal/ phung 4 mi rtag par rtogs pa log shes phyin ci log yin pa'i phyis der thal/ mdo las/ nyan thos dang / nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshos kyi sku la phyin ci 'dzig tu gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ༈ /ba'i r+sha spyadar+sha rnying dz+nyo shāspya mi shā /pa rnyi snang pa/9)( staX parnyi k+ṣiṃ ༵ ༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ dhī snro stos te phyin ci log tu bzhag pa ni phung 4 mi rtag pa la sogs pa bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin la bzhed pa yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis yang kha cig /rang nyid gcig lpu zhi bde don gnyer gyi shes rab kyang 'de'i nyan rang gi sgrib par 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ de 'dra yod kyang 'di'i sgrib pa bzhi ga dngos gnyen gyis spang rgyu'i sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na nyan rang gi de zhen tshul mi gcig pa ma gtogs phal cher bden 'dzin du shas che ba'i phyir/ dar ṭīka las/ de nas rim gyis zeg pa chen po'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sngar bshad pa'i sgrib pa de bzhi langoms par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis ma rig pas bstan par dri ma ma byed cig /gnyis pa rang lugs la/ gzhi shes kyi dmigs rnam bzhin du rang gi dmigs rnam byas 39
phar phyinaskabs bzhi pa/nas nyams su len pa'i mkhyen pa de/ gzhi shes sbrengar ba'i mtshan nyid/ nyams su len pa smos pas sems can gyi rgyud kyi yin par ston/ dbye na theg pa gsum ga'i gzhi shes sbyongar ba gsum yod de/ dmigs pa bden bzhi gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa gzhi shes kyi 'dzin stangs nyer bdun gang rung byas nas sgom pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sems dpa'i bh+yor ba de/ 'dir dngos su gtso 'or bstan pa'i sems dpa'i gzhi shes kyi spre1ra ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyer bdun/ rang gi ngos skal gyi nyon mongs kyi gnyen 4 byed pa'i skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rtog bral gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ skabs lanar dngos su bstan pa'i rang gi ngos skal gyi nyon mongs kyi gnyen ṭo mthong lam zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyan rang dang byang sems kyi bzhi yod/'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rang gi spang bya shes sgrib kyi gnyen ṭo byed pa'i zhen rig rjes la mngon rtogs de/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sgom lam zag bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang rgyal dang byang sems kyi lnga yod/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rang gi spang bya shes sgrib rags pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i rtog bral gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rang rgyal rtogs rigs kyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang rgyal dang byang sems kyi mthong lam drug 44da/ lam 'bras la gegs byed pa yang yin dngos gnyen gyi gzhom par bya ba de sgrib pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na du ma yod de/ sgrib tshul gyis dbus mtha' rtsa'agrel ltar bcu dang] thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la sgrib pa'i nyon sgrib shes sgrib gnyis dang] stobs bcu la sgrib pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa sogs gsum dang / gtsang bde rtag bdag dam pa'i phar phyin bzhi la sgrib pa'i bzhi yod/ thar pa thob pa la bar du gcod pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sgrib pa/ nyon sgrib spya dri/ /srad/ sbra paXgam dzi~X druṃ bya~X ༵palha spyu dzod shā ñcha dzī rdo kā pa smaṃ dam/ /sna /sa/ ṭ+wāṃ 40
gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshad/dngad grol ba dang] thar pa dag 'dra bas/ nyon sgrib kyi sgra bshad mtshan nyid des shes so/ /shes bya thams cad chags thogs med par mngon sum du mkhyen pa la bar du gcod pa'i cha nas bzhag rnyi/ /r+sha ༵ snye//shā sna snro rnyi ṭ+wāṃ / pa/ ny+pha twā/༵ r+sha smi/ ༵ ༷pa m+bhi pa ༵༵ spya raṃ ñcha zlo hūm̐ 11 pa /pa sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyis/ /nyams phyir slob ma bse ru dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi dag pa ste/ /zhes dang / de'i nyi snang las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi shes bya'i sgrib pa'i phyogs gcig rnam par dag pa ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyir dang / 'grel pa las kyang / de dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i phyogs gcig po gzung ba'i don gyi rnam par rtog pa dang /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid lhag ma bshad zin/ mdo dang bstan bcos kyi bshad tshul yodade/ mdo tshan nyer bdun gyis don rnam shes rnam gnyis gnyis bstan kyang bden pa so sor mi gsal ba rje btsun gyis dang po gsum la bzhi bzhi dang / lam bden la bco lngar bshad pa'i pyid gser 'phreng las/ mdo de dag la rje btsun gyis/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ /zhes sesnags kyis 'di nas 'di'i bar gyis gzhi shes dang/ lam shes dang/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bsnyan to zhes sa gcod mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisrtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/shes sgrib rags pa chos can/shes sgrib ma yin par thal/shes sgrib rags pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ nyon sgrib rags pa chos can/ nyon sgrib ma yin par thal/ nyon sgrib rags pa yin pa'i phyis khyab pa 'grig yang kho na re/ byed pa 4 bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam chos can/ skabs 'di'i bsgom bya'i lam bden gyi lam gyi rnam pa yin par thal/ lam la de ni bco lngar bshad/ /ces pa'i don rnam yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ khyab ste/ bden pa sesna so la bzhi dang / /zhes pa'i bsgom bya don rnam 41
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/la bden pa dang po gsum gang rung gi khyad par dgos pa'i phyig 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/bsgom bya lam bden gyi steng gi lam gyi rnam pa sgom byed yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ yang kho na re/skabs 'di'i lam bden gyi rnam padang de'i lam gyi 'dzin stangs thadad ma yin par thal/ byed pa 4 bdag med pa de'i lam sgya 'edzin stangs yin la de'i lam gyi rnam pa min/ de ltar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam de'i lam gyi rnam pa yin kyang de'i lam gyi 'dzin stangs ma yin pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa'i phyig dang 4 grub lte/ de ltar sgom pa lam bden gyi lam gyi 'odzin stangs sgom pa yin kyang/ de'i lam gyi rnam pa sgom pa ma yin pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de'i bedzin stangs sgom na de'i rnam pa sgom pas khyab ba'i pyig tsartags gnyis pa grub ste/ de 'dra'i mthong lam sgom pade lam bden gyi lam gyi rnam pa sgom pa yin kyang] de'i lam gyi 'dzin stangs sgom pa ma yin pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ de 'dra'i mthong lam sgom pa de lam bden gyi lam gyi rnam pa dang de'i lam gyi 'dzin stangs gnyis ka sgom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /don rnam shes rnam sgom pa yin khyab mnyam yin tshul bshad zin pa'i phyig des lam bden gyi rigs pa dang] sgrub pa dang/ nges 'byin sgom tshul yang shes dgos so/ /byas pa la kho na re/de'i lam gyi 'dzin stangs sgom parade lam gyi rnam pa sgom tshul ma yin par thal/de'i lam gyi rnam pa sgom tshe byed pa sho bden med rtogs pa'i mthong lam bden 'odzin gyi gnyen po yin par sgom dgos pa'i phyis der thal/ de 'dra'i mthong lam de de'i gnyen po yin pa de/ de 'dra'i mthong lam lam bden gyi rnam pa yin pa'i go don ma yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub lte/ nyi snang las/lam gyi rnam pasan te/ de ni byed pa po ma yin pa nyid kyis/ byed pa por 'dzin pa'i gnyen po yin pa'i pyid zhes gsungs pa'i pyid des rigs sgrub 'byin gsum la'ang zhib cha shes par bya'o/ /42
lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshadsmras pa/thub pas lho dang bar ta na dang byang nas byang / /sher phyin 'bri mchod thos bsam yid byed dge slong sogs/ /ngas dgongs gzigs bzhin rgyal kun gzigs shang dgongs gsungs pa/ /snying la bsam nas dus 'dir phan par dka' yang bshad/ /'phags seng gnyis nas sher don dus ring zhig //rtogs par gsungs bzhin re zhig ma rtogs kyang / /yid chad mi bgyi rtogs na tshe rabs kyi/ /rang gzhan don kun 'grub pas brtson pa skyed/ /don 'di rtogs dang sems la gus ci smos/ /glegs bam bgyid dang mchod bstod 〈snas 'bul dregags/ /nyan rang bsod nams las lhag thub dbang gis/ /'dzum bzhin 'od stong 'gyed bzhin bka' bstsal to/ /mthong na ngoms pa med pa'i thub dbang sku/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing spru ldang mchi ma brul/ /dad cing dad kyang ma tshim mgon khyod kyis/ /zab mo'i dbyangs kyis dbugs dbyung dus la babs/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pacasna/ /dang ba/ /lha ༵༵ rdzu shālhas kyi ṇā ma sna sprad/ snabathe/ñcha ṭā ༵ shām ḍā k+ṣiṃ r+sha k+ṣiṃ (dri / da/spya lha/ci/ lhags kyi phyogs la brten nas/ zhes pa nas/ sum cu rtsadrug yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di la 'phros/ bh+yor ba/ sbyodon/ mtha'adapyad pa bzhi/ dang po'i/ mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'de ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nas/ bka' bstsal pa/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid dmigs su med pa nyid kyi phyig zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo tshan so drug yod pa de rje btsun gyis bden pa so sor bh+yor tshul bshad pa la/ rgyu dang lam dang/ sogs byungaka slob dpon gyis de bas kyang bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa so so la grangs 'di ltar zhes bshad pa la drangs 43
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/ma thag pa 'di byung / gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nas/ dngos po med pa'ingo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyig zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug bstan te/ rgyu kun 'byung bden pa'i pa/shā ༵ 35 lha ༵ rnyi/shā n+d+ra dī /cu sna tshin+dha snro rnyit+na ((]spyaX (1 lha ṭ+wāṃ rtswa t+na] ni spyu chagasadang bral ba'i phar phyinanas/ sems can ma mchis pa'i phar phyin gyi bar brgyad kyis bshad pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ mdo las/ tshad ma mchis pa'i phar phyin nas/ chags pa ma mchis pa'i phar phyin gyi bar bdun gyis bshad pa'i phyid gsum pa grub ste/ mdo las mi rtag pa'i phar phyinanas/ mtshan nyid ma mchis pa'i phar phyin gyi bar lngas bshad pa'i phyid bzhi pa grub lte/ mdo las nang stong pa nyid kyi phar phyin nas/ dngos po med pa'i stong ba nyid kyi phar pyin gyi bar bcu drug gis bshad pa'i phyid bsnyan bcos las kyang lam shes kyi rnam pa'i zog mtha'i sa mtshams skabs 'dir dngos su ma bstan kyang rtogs mi nus pa'i skyon med de/ gzhi shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi thog mtha'i sa mtshams bzung bas rtogs sla ba'i phyirate/ gser 'tsheng las/de yang lam shes kyi rnam pa la sa gcodadangos su ma mdzad kyang/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid'gog /sdi dri bhe+e ljotsho sdum/ ga/shā r+shadī pa/ nā lhapa// snroshāsta ༵ r+shadī/ gh+nā ༵ lhasna spya dīr+shaX kun 'byung dang lam bden gnyis sngon la ston pa dgos pa du ma la dgongs pas skyon med de/gzhan las de ltar bshad pa mngon rtogs skye rim yin la/ 'dir rgyu 'bras don gyi rim pa'i shārnying slo k+ṣiṃ shāsno par r+shardo sprispri spri/marna ༵ r+shakā gh+nā pa/rapa snra spri smaṃ gh+nā pasnga( sta/ (( dīsta/ 44
lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshatwaspyipa da/spyarnyikhri spridī lha/gadzo ༵ ༵༵/ / rdzu r+ṇi shā ༷ji ༈ ༵ gli shā sna ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ 〉( ༷ gh+nā phyig der thal/ nyams su len tshe bstan tshul re re'i cha la'ang don rim dngad mngon rtogs kyi rim pa'i cha gnyis gnyis dgos par shes dgos pa'i phyir rte/ rnam bshad las/ 'dir ni skye rim dang mthun par bstan pa yin pas cha re re nas gnyis ka dbestos par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i steng gi lam shes kyi rnam pa 〈sna drug mdo las gsungs tshul yod de/ kun 'byung spang gnyen sgo nas rnam pa brgyad dang / lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad par+sha shā /lhan rna lhaḍū ji dz+nyo (3(5 ṭ+wāṃ dī cu/ spri/ pa// shārnyi sbyoX kau sna za kau r+sha rjo r+shat+na dīr+sha/ sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes 〈snas can/ kun 'byung gi rgyu'i rnam pa gang yin pa yul ma 'ongs la sred pa'i 'dun pa dang / mi 'bral bar sred pa'i 'dod chags dang] yang srid la dga' ba'i sred pa'i gnyen so yin te/ yul de thob par 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba dang/ yul la chags zhen gyis mi gnas pa dang/ yul la sred pa zhi ba'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ chos can 'chad par/(lha ༵༷ )pa]/ /lha' kau da/(lhasalha /sna /sa/ dz+nyo/ ༵༵ ba sdishāng/ dz+nyo tshor+sha spya pashā spra dang / mi gnas pa dang / zhi ba dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyis yang mthong lam de chos can/ de'i kun 'byung gi rnam pa gang yin pa/ 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi gnyen po yin te/ chags snang 31ngas gsum gyi zhen yul med pa'i rnam can yin pa'i phyig gosnas ni/ 'grel pa las/ kun 'byung ba gang yin pa ste 'dod chags dang/ zhe snang dngad gti mug dang/ zhes byung/rtags ni/ 'grel ba las/ 'dod chags med pa dang / zhe snang med pa dngad gti mug med pa dang/45

lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshad/phyiganyi snang las/rten par byed pa'i bdag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dri tsam yang med/ ces dang]gser 'tsheng las kyang ngo| /de chos can/ bdag med pa yin te/ rang nyid bdag ma yin pa'i phyir te/nyi snang las/ rang nyid bdag ma yin pas dreg/ /zhes 〈sna/ /gser 'tsheng las serdzo/ /de chos can/mtshan nyid med pa'i ngo bo yin te/ don dam par stong pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las sesna/ /mdo las mi rtag pa nas mtshan nyid ma mchis pa'i bar lnga gsungs then/ /bzhi pa 'gog bden phan yon gyi rnam pa bshad pa la/ dang po 'a4stog pa'i rnam pa ni/ rang pyi shā pa/ shā lha m+p+raṃ ṭ+wāṃ /sna rnyinā snang lhasnas gh+nā ༵ paspyu ༵ dz+nyo padzi~X ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ lha'i sna pyā hā la bden zhen dgag pas rab tu phye ba'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ nye snang la sa/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa gsum gsungs pa ni/ zhes sesna/ /zhi ba'i rnam pa ni/ shes sgrib kyi sa bon zhi ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi 'gog pa chos can/ stong pa nyid dang/ chen ṭo dang] don dam pa dngaka 'dus byas dang]'dus ma byas dang / mtha' 'das dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa brgyad yod de/ kun btags pa'i bdag stong nyid la bden zhen bral ba dang] sdod kyi 'jig rten la dang / don dam pa myang 'das la dang / 'dus byas la dang / 'dus ma byas la dang]rtag pa dang chad mtha' la dang / lha'or ba thog ma med pa la dang / rtogs pa'i chos dor ba med pa la bden par zhen par dgag pas phye ba'i bral ba rnams 〈snad pa'i pyig chos ni 'grel pa las/stong pa dang / nas/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa lte brgyad dang / zhes dang / rtags ni/'grel pa las/ zhi ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo nyid btags pa'i bdag stong pa dang / nas/ zhen pa dgag pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyiganyi snang las kyang / mngon par zhen pa rnam pa brgyad kyi gnyen por btags pa 'gog pa'i rnam pa brgyadacas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gsum pa gyanyesam gyi rnam pa ni/49
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/de chos can/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ byed pa po gzhan gyis kun btags pa'i byed pa por zhen pa dgag pas phye ba'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ ji ltar gya nom pa rang bzhin gyis dang] zhes so/ /bzhi pa nges 'byung gi rnam pa ni/ de chos can/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang] rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang] mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa ste/ ji ltar nges par 'byung tshul gsumatsand de/ gzugasanas rnam mkhyen bar yul du zhakhrul ba'i bden btags dang/ gzugs rung sogs mtshan nyid du bden par zhakhrul ba dang1 ladas sogs dus su bden par 'khrul bdagag pas rab tu phye ba'i bral ba gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/nges par 'byung ba'i/ nas/ rnam pa ste gsum dang / zhes so/ /gang nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa chos can/ dngos 4 med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gcig ste/ gzhan gyis sgro btags pa'i thar pa lta bu ma yin pa'i phyis chos thams cad la bden par zhen pa'i ngo bo nyid dgag pas rab tu phye ba'i bral ba yin pa'i sgyig 'grel pa las/nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa khon nyid dgag pas dngos 4 med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gcig lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbzhi pa mtha' dpyad pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la kha cig na re/ rgyu dang lam dang / zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i lam shes sbrengar ba yin na/ stong nyid rtogs pas khyab zer na/ 'o na/ de dag brgyad dang / zhes pa'i kun 'byung bden pa'i yul ma 'ongs pa la sred pa'i zhen yul med par rtogs pa'i lam shes bh+yor ba chos can/ der thal/de'i mir/ khyab pa khas/ de brgyad kyi dang po yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de 'dra'i sred pa dang dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa dngos 'gal du zhugs pa'i sbyongar ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi nyon mongs brgyad 4 gang rung gi zhen yul med pa yin na chos kyi bdag med phra mo ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyon mongs yin pa'i 50
lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshad/phyir/ gzhan yang / skabs 'di'i lam shes kyi sbyi1ra ba la theg chen gyi rtogs rigs kho nas khyab par thal/ de la stong nyid rtogs pas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ mdo las/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang] rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya/ zhes pa'i don ma grub par thal/ byang sems rgyud kyi lam shes khungar ba la rtogs rigs gsum med pa'i phyig gzhan yang] skabs 'dir gnyen po'i rab dbye shes pa'i ched du ston pa ma yin par thal/skabs 'der de la stong nyid rtogs pas khyab pa'i phyis 'dod na/ brgya don gsum gyi dbye ba'i skabs dang 'gal lo/ /yang kha cig /theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i lam shes sbyongar ba la stong nyid rtogs pas khyab zer na/ 'dir bstan lam bden gyi lam gyi rnam pa'i lam shes sbyordzor ba gnyis chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ sems cad tshad med pa la r+sha pa'i kyi shā spru papa dri ār+sha ༷) shārnyi /sdu (lha tram̐ ṭā ༈ ༵༵ /lha /shu spyan/ ༵༵ hūm̐ /pa /shā shes par gyis/ 'dod na/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun gyi lam bden gyi rnam pa la byed pa po bdag med rtogs pa'i bh+yor ba lam gyi rnam pa yin par rtogs pa'i spyor ba gcig grangs la 'dren rigs par thal/ 'dir 'drin tshul de'i pyir na ma khyab ste/ sngar sgyi don de'i phyid gzhan rnyit+na k+ṣiṃ (spyan n+dha sna rnyinam dwo shā ) ༵ hūm̐ (dri ༷༷ma (sna ts+tsha r+sha pa/ dzinak+ta ga/two (r+shadī/ snroshā pa'i phyig byas pa la kho na re/ de'i bh+yor ba dang po bzhi chos can/ lam shes sbrengar ba ma yin par thal/ gzhi shes sbyongar ba yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sprengar ba yin na lam shes sgyor ba dang rnam mkhyen sgyor ba gnyis ka yin dgos pa'i sgyid rnam rdzogs lhor ba dang go 51
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/sgrub don gcig yin pa'i pyid byas pa la kho na re/ gzhi shes bh+yor ba yin na lam shes spyor ba yin pas khyab par thal/ sems dpa'i de la de'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes spyor ba yin na/ lam shes rgyur ba dang rnam mkhyen bh+yor ba ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyig der thal/ de gnyis kyi rgyud kyi lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi nya5sa len med pa'i phyir te/mdo las/ thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan zos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /zhes sogs kyi don yod pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ 'dir bstan 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug gi rnam can gyi lam shes spyor ba bcu drug 'gog bden gyi rnam pa can yin zer na/ de dag chos can/ bral ba'i rnam pa can yin par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa can du thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ lam shes skya rtogs par bya ba/ lam shes kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ lam shes de'i rtogs par bya ba de/ lam shes de'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyis 'dod na/zeg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi rtogs par bya ba yin par thal/ de'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ gser 'phreng gi mkhyen gsum dang 'gal lo/ /yang kha cig na re/ lam shes yin na 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i lam shes yin pas khyab zer na/ 'bras bu lam shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i nyid 'dod mi nus te/ rnam grangs pa'i zag bcas ma yin pa'i phyisder thal/ medod sred kyi zag pa yod kyang gtso bor mi spong bar rgyud la ldan pa'i skabs kyi lam shes ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ lam shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyon mongs pa shin tu ma spangs pa'i phyir/ zag pa dang bcas pa kho na yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ kho na'i don yod pa'i phyis52
lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas bshadgnyis pa rang lugs la/ lam shes kyidon rnam gang rung shar bar byasanas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i spyor bde/ ṇ+ḍa'idangos bstan gyi lam shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbyen so drugayod/ snar bstan rnam pa lalangadon rnamadang spyor ba'i shes rnam sogasayod/ lam shes nyams su len pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i semasadapa'iye shes/ lam shes spyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dedang semasadapa'i mngon rtogasadonagacig sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lamanas rgyun ma7) b.ra'agad/gsum pa rtsod spong la/ kho na re/ skabs 'deradangos su bstan pa'i lam shes spyor ba rnams rang rgyud ldan gyis sgom pas khyab par thal/dedag bsgom byayin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/rnam pa brgyadangadon gsum sgom byasan pa'i phyis 'dod mi nusate/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyide'adzid pa'i phyig yang khon re/ kun 'byung gi rnam pa la blten pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lam shes sprungar ba chos can/ gzhi shes sbyongar ba kho na yin par thal/ de gang zhig /lam shes bh+yor bar lazhug tshul med pa'i phyis dang po grub ste/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i bh+yor bayin pa'i phyir zeran/ tsartags gnyis pa ma grub ste/ srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis sel ba'i bh+yor bayin pa'i phyir khyab ste/ lam shes kyi lam shes tshul mtha' gnyis lasag pa'i lam la mkhasadagos pa'i phyig ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub lte/ rtsabag shes pas srid la mi gnas shing/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnasadang/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rabadang lhag bsam gyi snying rjes zin pa'i lam re res kyang mtha' gnyis ka bsal nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thar pa'i go skabs chen po 'byod pa'i mig mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa len ni sems can tshad ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nas/ sher phyin 'di ni mtha' gnyis su mi ltang pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis tshul gong 'og gi lam shes gzhi shes sbyongar ba'i khyad par gyi sgo brgya phye ba legs so/ /53
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/smras pa/yang yang rgya chen lam dang bsam pa sbyangs/ /lci lci sems can khur khyer rgyal sras rnams/ /mtho maro'i sa lam rim bzod sangs rgyas pa/ /bsam bsam kun 'byung thob pa'i dga' ston rmad/ /mkhas kyang trags dka' pha rol pyin pa'i gnad/ /'chad mkhan mang yang tshig don 'dab stong gi /don gyi gnad sor tshig gi lo ma'i khur/ /mthong nas 'phags seng gnad don nor bu 'dzin/ /so drug lam shes sbyongar ba'i rgyan ldan pa'i/ /lam shes lha dbang khyod kyi rnam pa'i spyan/ /'khral ba'i mi 'dzum rgyal sras yongs 'du la/ /theg chen lag ldan steng nas gzigs sam snyam/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /54
rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mdor bsnyan/gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad par/rtsabag dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung lte/ /sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar zug rnams/ /lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun par/ /kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na/ /zhes byung / 'phros khu1ra ba mtha' dbyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes pa nas/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du gangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya rtsabacu yod pa'i byang phyogs so bdun mdo bdun gyis/ lam shes kyi so bzhi mdo bcu drug gis/ rnam mkhyen gyi so dgu mdo bdun gyis bshad pa de bstan bcos su thog mtha'i mtshams kyi sgo nas gsum du 'chad par drangs ma thag pa dang / slob dpon gyis 'chad pag dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ sogs byung /gser 'phreng las/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa so bdun 4 lde tshan re re la re re ste mdo bdun dang /so bzhi la rnam thar brgyad la gcig snyoms 'jug dgu la gcig spong lam la gcig gzhan bcu gsum la re re ste bcu drug dang / so dgu la tha ma gsum la re re/ gzhan sde tshan bzhi la re re nye mdo bdun yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa ni/ yum 'di ni dran pa/ nas/sangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya rtsabacu bshad de/ de la ga thos la yod pa dang mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang bh+yor ba so bdun/byang sems la yod pa dang mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang lhor ba rtso bzhi/ sangs rgyas kho na'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa dang lhor ba so dgu bshad pa'i phyigmtha' dpyad pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po la rtsod pa dang lan gnyis/ dang 55
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/4 la/ kha cig re/ gang zag gsum la 〈snad pa'i kun mkhyen gsum du bshad tshul de mi 'thad par thal/ 'di'i rnam pa rnam mkhyen kho na dang rten yang sangs rgyas kho na la bshad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir zhes rtsod tshul/ gser 'phreng las/ rtsod pa ni/ gal te/ zhes so/ /de'i lan 'od snga ma kha cig na re/ de mi 'gal te/ dngos su sangs rgyas kho na la yod cing rnam mkhyen yin kyang / rten gsum la yod pa dang / mkhyen pa gsum du phye ba 'phags pa thams cad kyi n+dha dzo/ lha( /shā sbyi lha sdipa paspri ༷ba/shes( rnyisno dri /nyiX ༷ /sna (zhu 〉 parnyi k+ṣiṃ sbyo khye/sna ༵ rgyur bzhag gi rnam mkhyen la serdzo bdun dang dren bzhi mi zer te/ tshig gsal las/ gzhan dag ni/ nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu'i rnam par bzhag gi dngos su thams cad shes pa dang lam shes pa'i rnam par gong du drangs te rtsi'o/ /zhes rtso/ /de la dang po mi 'thad par thal/sangs rgyas sa'i lam shes gzhi shes btags pa bar mi rung ba'i pyid der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa gzhi shes lam shes ma lus pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun pag /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de'i rjes mthun de lam de yin pa la byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas spras zlo (༷ ma/shā lha/ pa hāXpa sbyi /ma/ shārnyi ma/ ṭ+wāṃ sna/ ( pa~Xsdi pa ༵ par+sha/ dīspra shā/ nyi snang las kyang] de la lam gyi bden pa dang rjes su mthun pa ni 'di yin no/ /lam ni gsum lte thams cad shes pa nyid kyi lam dang / lam shes pa nyid kyi lam dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam mosna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis yang lugs gnyis pa rgyur bshad pa yang mi 'thad par thal/ spyir yul yang yod kyang/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yang so bdun dang serdzo bzhi la 56
rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mdor bstan/—rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yang yod pa'i phyig zur dang bo grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ rnam mkhyen ni yul gzhi lam rnam gsum dang yul can mkhyen gsum la brten pa'i rnam pa mtha' dag gi yul can yin pas 'di'i rnam pa ston pa na gzhi shes dang lam shes gnyis kyi rnam pa yang ston dgos la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zur gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam bshad las/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la mkhyen pa gsum yod pa de dang por lam 'og ma gang gi gnas skabs su bskyed pa dang /mkhyen pa gsum du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan dregags mi shes pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig kha cig na re/ 'phags pa 'og ma dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na 'phags pa 'og ma dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen yod par thal/ de'i rnam pa yod pa'i phyig rtags khas/ 'dod na/ 'phags pa 'og ma'i rnam mkhyen yod par thal lo/ /byas pa la kho na re/ rtsabs slob ma thun mong chos rnams dang] /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ byang phyogs so bdun nyan thos dang sangs rgyas thun mong gi chos dang stobs bcu thun mong ma yin pa'i chos ma yin pa'i pyir na ma khyab/ byang phyogs de gnyis kyi thun mong gi chos sam yon tan ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis kyi yon tan gyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig /'di'i thun mong dang zun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis gang zag de'i rtogs rigs sgo nas zer na/ 'o na/ rten byang sems la bzhag pa'i so bzhi gang rung la byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pas khyab par thal lo/ /dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gnyen po'i lam rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/rtags sla/ 'dod na/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen theg chen rtogs rigs yin par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i phyir/ ladod na/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med par rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen yang zeg chen rtogs rigs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas sa 57
phar phyinaskabs bzhi pa/na nyan rang gi rtogs rigs mi 'thang par thal lo/ /de dag gang la'ang 'dod mi nus te/ 'dir byang sems kyi rtogs rigs min yang rigs can gsum rjes su gzung ba'i ched du byang sems kyi lam shes la rtogs rigs gsum yod pa'i mig gzhan yang / skabs 'dir bstan pa'i byang phyogs so bdun r+ṇa thos kyi rtogs rigs yin par thal/ thun mong gi don de'i phyir/ gdod mi nusate/ skabs 'de'i dran pa nyer bzhag sogs tshogs lam nas bzung ste byang chub sems dpa' kho nas gtso bor sgom pa'i nyid ma khyab na khyab par thal/ byang sems kyi dran pa nyer bzhag kyang zeg dman gyi dran pa nyer bzhag las khyad par bcu bzhis lhag pa'i phyis mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan dran pa nyer bzhag pa/ /sgom pa rnam pa bcu bzhi yis/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir na de/ /de las gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gong gi ma khyab mtshams la rtags grub lte/ rnam bshad las/ byang phyogs so bdun rten tha dad pa'i sgo nas mkhyen pa gsum tha dad pa'i rnam gzhag byed pa'i tshe nyan thos kyi rtogs pa'i rigs su bzhag par rigs pa yin na yang /skabs 'der dran pa nyer bzhag dang por tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su sgom pa'i tshul 'de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi bsgom par bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig nyid kyi don yod pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ sangs 'phags kyi stobs bcu byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa zer na/ 'o na/ de bcu sangs rgyas dang byang sems 'phags pa'i bsgom bya thun mong ba yin par thal/ ngo bo'i sgo nas thun mong yin pa lasdog dka' ba'i phyig 'dod na/ de bcude gnyis da'i bsgom bya yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i mig medodan/ sangs rgyas rmya san nyams lenawend par thal/ den sgom byed pa7(da pa'i phyidrang lugs la/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya rtsabacu 4 gang rung gi don rnam legs par shar bas de'i zlog zla la gnod byed kyi sems dpa'i ye shes de/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan 58
rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mdor bstan/gtso bo'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye ba brgya dang bcu yod/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i bsgom bya'i rnam mkhyen la brgya dang bcu yod de/ nyan thos la yod pa dang mthun pa'i de so bdun dngad byang sems la yod pa dang mthun pa'i so bzhi dang / thun mong ma yin pa sangs rgyas kho na la yod pa dang mthun pa'i rtso dgu yod pa'i phyis rang gi lde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rnam mkhyen de/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid du 'jug thun mong ba'i don yang sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'og ma la yod ba de yin pa'i phyid de la nyan thos la yod pa dngad byang sems la yod pa gnyis rtso/ /de ltar phye ba'i dgos pa gnyis gnyis yod de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi de'i rigs thog mar lam gang gi skabs su bskyed pa dang / rnam gzhag gi rten so sor shes pa'i dgos pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dper na sangs 'phags kyi byang phyogs sde tshan bdun bzhin no/ /rtsod spong la kho na re/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen dang byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen yod par thal/ 'phags pa 'og ma la yod pa dang mthun pa'i shun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi so so yang dag rig pa bzhi chos can/shun mong ba'i de yin par thal/ rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa byang 'phags la yod pa'i phyir/byang sems sa dgu pa bas de bzhi thob pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan las/ so so yang dag rig blo bzang / /sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rjes su mthun pa la ming btags pa'o/ /'o na sa bcu pa ba sangs 'phags yin par thal/ sa bcu'i ye shes sangs rgyas kyi sa yin pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni/ /gang gi sangs rgyas sar gnas pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhakhor gsum/ gzhan yang / sdud se yang dag rig pa bzhi thob pa la/ chags zogs kyi sgrib pa gnyis spangs mi dgos par thal de 59
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/sa dgu ba na yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ mdo las de ltar bshad pa gang zhig /'phags pas kyang de ltar bzhed pa'i pyid dang po grub ste/ 'di'i mdo las/ bka' bstsal pa/ ye shes thams cad la chags pa med pa dang thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ nyi snang las/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i thams cad la ye shes chags pa med pa dang thogs pa med pa'i phyig zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub lte/ nyi snang las/ so so yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rtogs pa'i ro myong bar mi byed pas na chags pa med pa'i phyir dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pas thogs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gags sgrib 'ogs sgrib kyi ngo 'o dang/ de med tshul de ltar yin no/ /60
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ so bdun dang / so bzhi bshad pa dang / rnam mkhyen so dgu bshad pa gsum/ dang 4 ni/ 'grel pa las/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid la/ zhes sesnags la/byang phyogs so bdun gyi sbyo'i don dang/ so so'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la dbye ba dang/ sgom tshul dang / sa mtshams dang / rdzas btags dang / sgra bshad dang lnga/ dang 4 ni/ skabs 'di'i shes rnam la byang phyogs so bdun yod de/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang / yang dag spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad yod pa'i pyir/ gnyis pa de dag gi sgom tshul gyi gtso 'o yod de tshogs lam chung ngu na dran nye dang / 'bring na yang dag spong ba dang / chen po na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / drod rtseganyis na dbang pho lnga dang / bzod mchog gnyis na stobs lnga dang / mthong lam na byang lag dang / sgom lam na lam gyi yan lag sgom pa yod pa'i phyir/dang po gsum grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ tshogs lam na sde tshan dang pho gsum dang / zhes dang / 'jug 'grel las/ de la sems bskyed pa dang 4 na dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom la/ gnyis pa na yang dag spong pa'o/ /gsum pa na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bzhi pa dang lnga pa grub lte/ dbus mtha' las/ dbang 4 rnams dang stobs rnams la/ /nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis gnyis sdud/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig drug pa dang bdun pa grub lte/ gtso che bas de ltar byas kyang gnyis ka na yan lag gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ gser 'phreng las/ de yang mthong lam na byang lag dang sgom lam na lam gyi yan lag 'grog pa ni gtso che ba yin gyi dang po na yang lam gyi yan lag 'amad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gsum pa de dag gi sa mtshams 61
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/yod de/ sgom tshul gtso bor byas nas dang po gsum de ltar bshad kyang sde tshan dang po gsum ga tshogs lam chung ngu na yod/ dbang 4 lnga drod nas thob/ stobs lnga bzod pa nas thob/ byang chub yan lag dang lam yan lag kyang mthong lam dang lhan du thob pa'i phyir/ dang 'o grub ste/tshogs lam chung ngu nas zhi lhag zung 'brel yang yod pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa yod na dang po gnyis lta ci smos pa'i pyid mdzod las/ zhi gnas grub par gyur pa yi/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mig khyab ste/ rdzu 'phrul sgya rkang pa'i sa mtshams ni/ rnam bshad las/ ting nge 'dzin 'di dag rdzu 'phrul 'grub pa'i gzhi'i gtso 4 yin pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /'di yang lam gsum rim pa bzhin du gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gyur bar shes pa'i ched du tshogs lam chen 4 dang sbyar yang tshogs lam chung ngu'i gnas skabs nas kyang grub par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ yang dag slong ba'i sa mtshams kyang de na yod pa'i phyir te/ des na yang dag slong ba'i dad pa dang brtson 'grus rgyud ldan gyi tshogs lam thob ma thag yod pa'i pyid bshes springs las/ mgo'am gos la slo bur me lhasnar na/ /sogs kyi khyad par tshogs lam pa la yod pa'i phyir/ lam gyi gtso 'o rnam gsum las/ de ltar goms pas lubror ba'i phun tshogs la/ /yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / /nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo/ /byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/rnam bshad las/ yang dag spong ba nus pa khyad par can rnyed pa dang / dran pa nyer bzhag sgom pa'i 'bras bu shes pa'i ched du tshogs lam 'bring dang sbyar yang mtshan nyid tshang ba tshogs lam chung ngu nas kyang bskyed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ martags gnyis pa dang gsum pa sla/ ②rtags bzhi pa grub ste/ mthong lam thob pa na byang phyogs so bdun thob pas khyab pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras byang chub phyogs mthun pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad 62
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/ni/ /rtag tu mthong ba'i lam de dang / /lhan cig tu ni thob par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i pyigkhyab ste/ de'i 'grel pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos dran pa la drenags pa sna tshogs pa thams cad mthong ba'i lam de dang lhan cig thob par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ byang phyogs dren bdun 'byed pa ming gi ldog gas 'byed kyang rdzas su bcu yin te/ mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi so bdun la ngag dang / las mtha' dang/k+ṣiṃ bzlo snyim( // m+p+raṃ ba/snang k+ṣiṃ ṭī druṃ dngad /gdī n+d+ra rtsu rnyi sna pa/ /mi pa (5 khri/ hādī k+ṣiṃ shin sbyangs bcur 'dus pa'i pyid mdzod las/ ming gi sgo nas rdzas su bcu/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /shes rab ting 'dzin btang snyoms dga'/ /rtog dang tshul khrims shin tu 3 wa/ / / wa// /t+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ//wa/ // wa/ ༷ rnye/hūṃ /yam̐ / ༷ / pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ zad mi skye shes pa ni byang chub yin la de dang mthun pas de skad brjod pa'i pyid mdzod las/ zad dang mi skye shes pa ni/ /byang chub de dang mthun nyid phyir/ /sum cu rtsabadun de phyogs mthun/ /zhes so/ /'dir mtha' cung zad dpyad na/ khyod kyi sa mtshams de mi 'thad par thal/ dran nye tshogs lam dang/ yang dag spong ba drod dang/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rtsemo dngan dbang 4 bzod pa/ stobs chos mchog 'phags lam mthong lam dang / byang lag sgom lam nas 'job dgos pa'i phyir/ mdzod 63
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/las/ sde tshan bdun ni go rim bzhin/ /las ni dang po pa dag dngan /nges 'byed cha mthun rnams dang ni/ /sgom dang mthong la rab tu phye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de bye mdo'i lugs tsam bshad pa yin pa'i phyis de la kha cig na re/ mdzod kyi de nyan thos kyi rgyud la skye tshul yin pa'i phyir zer ba shin tu tha chad yin par thal/ de ni bye smra'i zeg pa gsum ga'i byang phyogs kyi skye tshul yin pa'i phyir te/ gser 'phreng las/ chos so bdun gang gi rgyud la de ltar 'dod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig gis/ 'grel pa'i tshig zin ltar sde tshan bdun rim can kho na dang tshogs lam gsum la rim gyis skye zer na mi 'thad par thal/ de khyad par can gyi sgom tshul tsam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ kun btus dang 'grel pa sogs kyi bshad tshul sgom tshul tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ gser 'tsheng las/ de ltar na tshogs lam na sde tshan dang 4 gsum dang/drod rtsenas dbang sa/ bzod mchoganas stobs sgom par kun btus sogasanas gsungs pa lanani spyi'i rnam gzhag yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang/ tshogs lam chung ngu na dran nye rdzu 'phrul rkang padang yangadag spong ba cig car du sgom pa med par thal/ de dag tshogs lam gsum la rim can kho nar skyed pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ kun btus las/ yang sgom pa ni 'dun pa dang] brtson 'grus dang/ rtsol ba dang] spro ba dang] mthun pa dang/ phyir nur ba med pa dang/ dran pa dang]shes bzhin dang / bag yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ nyes pa dgu'i gnyen por de dgu sgom pa'i phyir/ don sbyo chags pa gcig gis bltas na ltad mo yod do/ /tshig mi gcig pas don tha dad par rdzas su bcur bshad/ gzhan yang / tshogs lam chen 4 thob nas kyang sde tshan gsum sgom dus cig car sgom pa gcig med par thal/ tshogs lam chung ngu la de'i phyig khyab ste/ tshogs lam chung ngu bsan na yang dag spong ba bzhi thob pas khyab pa'i pyid kun btus las/ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ brtson 'grus so/ /zhes dang sgom tshul yang/ kun btus las/ sgom pa gang 64
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/zhe na/ gang 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu bedzin to/ /rab tu lasdog go zhes bya ba lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig de tsam yang ma thob zer na/ tshogs lam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyang dge bshes shig go/de dag dbyad pa'i sgo yin no/ /gnyis pa so so'i dka' gnas kyi mtha' dpyad pa la/ sde tshan bdun las/ dang yo ni/'grel pa las/ dang por dngos 4 la yongs su rtogs pa'i lam/ zhes sogs byung / mtha' dpyad pa la dgag gzhag spang gsum las/ dang 4 la kha cig na re/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi la dmigs nas rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis su brtags pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab de/dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi shes rab chos can/mtshan nyid der thal/ de'i phyid khyab pa khas/ rtags sla/ 'dod na/ ting nge 'dzin shes rab yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ bdag med yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig gis/ de ltar ladzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab dang mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i shes rab chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ de'i pyid khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ rang bzhin gyi dran pa nyer bzhag yin pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ dran pa nyer bzhag shes rab 4/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes rab dang mtshungs ldan yin par thal/ ting nge bedzin shes rab dang mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de'i phyig gdod mi nus te/shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na rdzas mtshungs nyams so/ /gzhan yang / lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi shes rab dang mtshungs ldan gyi ting nge 'odzin chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ de'i phyigkhyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ 'brel ba'i dran pa nyer bzhag yin pa'i phyig der thal/ rang bzhin gyi dran pa nyer bzhag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems byung yin ba'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ gzhan ni 'brel dang dmigs pa las/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang 'grel las/ de dang 65
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/lhan cig 'byung ba'i chos rnams ni 'brel ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis rtsabar 'dod na/ de chos can/ ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs ldan yin par thal/ ting nge 'odzin shes rab dang mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de'i phyig rtags dngos/ yang kha cig /de bzhi la mtshan nyid gnyis su brtags nas sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs sngar ltar mtshan nyid zer na/ thos byung gi dngad bsam byung gi de gnyis re re nas chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ thos bsam snyom gsum ga'i dran pa nyer bzhag 〈snad pa'i phyis mdzod las/ shes rab 〈snas zugags las byung bcas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis yang kha cig na re/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi la dmigs nas rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis su rtog par byed pa'i shes pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ lam ma zhugs na dran pa nyer bzhag yod par thal/ de na de 'dra yod pa'i phyig de na de thob kha ma 〈snad pa'i pyig rtags sla/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang phyogs zug bdun lam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / lus tsam la dmigs nas mi gtsang ba'i rdzas dren gnyis tsam sgom pa'i byang sems kyi dran pa nyer bzhag chos can/ de bzhi la dmigs nas rang sbyo'i mtshan nyid gnyis su rtog par byed pa'i shes pa yin par thal/ dran pa nyer bzhag yin pa'i ṭā sezipa dpa~X /ni rtasna ltaX nā/ snoswā kau ༵ hūm̐ m+p+raṃ]r+sha/n+d+ra gh+nā sna druṃ /sna dī trā pa pa~X//tshor+sha ༵ ṭ+wāṃ nā dī ༵༵ rdzun kau ṭā ba/zhu dī k+ṣiṃ ༵ dī shā/ shā rnyikhya/ gh+nā dzo da/ zlo sprab ba r+shasdu ༵ chos/ mi /shā ༵༷ de drangs pa'i mig 'dod mi nus te/ dmigs pa'ang de bzhi ga ma dmigs la/ mtshan nyid kyang gnyis su ma brtags pa'i mig der thal/ dmigs pa lus tsam dang rang gi mtshan nyid tsam la brtags pa'i phyig gzhan yang / rang gi lus la sems can thams cad kyi lus su bsam ste/66
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/sems can thams cad kyi lus sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gnas su bsam pa'i byang sems kyi dran pa nyer bzhag chos can/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi la dmigs nas rang sgyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis su brtags pa'i shes rab tu thal 'dzi/ /byang sems kyi lus dran pa nyer bzhag yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus la lus kyi rjes su lta ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa sgom pa/ bdag gi lus sems can thams cad kyi lus nye bar 'dogs shing bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi lus sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gnas la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ dmigs pa bzhi la ma yin la sgyi'i mtshan nyid tsam gyis sgom pa'i phyig des lus dran pa nyer bzhag la'ang phyi'i lus nang gi lus phyi nang gnyis lnga'i lus la dmigs pas ma khyab pa'ang shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / byang sems sbyongar lam pa'i lus bdag med du rtogs pa'i lhag mthong du gyur pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig rtags grub ste/ lus sbyi mtshan gyi sgo nas rtogs pa'i de yin pa'i pyig de 'dra'i lus dran pa nyer bzhag yod pa'i phyis chos yang /pa ༵༵ /shā ༵ /rdzu/ naspras/ sna zlo ṭ+wāṃ /dī dī byi( // pa/ tram̐ sna padzo go/ ni k+ṣiṃ /shā sna ༵༵༵ pa'i phyis rtsabar gdod mi nus te/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong du ma zad bsam byung la yang chos can mi snang bar 'dod dgos pa'i pyid mdo las/ de thams cad ni nam mkha' ltar mazong ste/ de lus yongs su shes pa'i pyir/ gang du yang dran pa mi 'jug go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyigde ltar smra bas sgra rtog gi sel 'jug kyang mi shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang] byang sems kyi rgyud kyi tshor ba bden med du rtogs pa'i tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag chos can/ de bzhi la rang sbyi'i mtshan nyid du rtogs par thal/ dran pa nyer bzhag yin pa'i phyig der thal/ de 'dra yod pa'i phyig 'dod mi 67
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/nus/ des sems chos gnyis la'ang shes par bya'o/ /rang lugs la/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa/ dbye ba/ grogs/ sgom tshul/'bras bu/ sgra bshadadang bdun/dmigs pa lus tshor sems chos bzhi gang rung la dmigs nas rang sgyi'i mtshan nyid ci rigs su brtags te sems pa'i shes rab kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i mkhyen pa //na pa~X ñjadī bsgri ༵ ༵ shā/ ②(/ drasna pa/pa /shā (pa /ma /spra/ n+dha /spya ༵ sprisna lha /shā spra/ /nga/ daXr+sha dī btāzlodede/ ༈ /dī kā ༈ shā dzoskyupa(dī]sa (( dri spride~X ༵ bta( /rdzu(spya ༵༵ dmigs pa gang zhen/ lusadang] tshor bdang/ semasadang/ chos dreg/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ dbye na rten nyan rang byang sems kyi gsum dang] dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhi yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ shes rab dang dran pa kho nar ma zad de/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi grogs sems smyung dang sems kun der lezhug pa'i pyid kun btus las/ grogs gang zhe na/ de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i semasadang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams serdzo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid mdzod las kyang / gtso 4 smos pa de dag ni/ /lhor byung yon tan kun kyang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidhūm̐ ( ༷/lha snyenā ba spyanapa ༵ /lhan/ ༈ lha n+d+ra na ༵ spras pa/ gh+nā /pa m+b+ya shāspya snag pa/sna rdza] chos dran pa nyer bzhag gis lam bden la 'jug pa'i phyis dbus mtha' las/ gnasangan len phyir sred rgyu'i mig /gzhis phyiradang ma slongs phyis /bden pa bzhi la 'jug bya bas/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa sgoms/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid go rim gyi rgyu mtshanazungadade/ pyis pa rnamasadang por bdag gi gnas dang / de nas tshor ba 4 la longs spyod/ de nas sems la bdag gi dngos 68

phar phyinaskabs bzhi pa/gsum pa rtsod pa slong ba la kho na re/ 'der byang sems kyi gtso bor lus dran pa nyer bzhag la chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam canaskumad par thal/theg chen zun mong mayin pa'ide 'thad pa'i phyisgdod na/ de sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzhi shes kyi bh+yor ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/khyab par thal/ rnam bshad las/ nyan thos skya rtogs rigs su shes par bya ba dang] de dang rjes su mthun par byang chub sems dpas bsgom pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ 'dir bstan 'i rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med rnam can gyi nyer bzhag la dgongs kyi 'dir bstan thams cad la ma yin pa'i phyisgnyis pa rtsol ba'i lam yang dag slong ba bzhi ni/ 'grel pa las/ de'i 'og tu zhugs pa la brtson 'grus 'byung ba'i rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la zhes sogs byung/ sbyongar ba dang mtha' dbyad pa gnyis/ shes bya chos can/ dran pa nyer bzhag 'og tuyang dag spong ba bzhi bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dran pa nyer bzhag sgom pas spang gnyen blang dor la spro ba'i brtson 'grus 'byung ba'i phyismtha' dpyad pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la kha cig na re/ spang gnyen la blang dor byed par spro ba'i brtson 'grus de yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ mtshan nyid de rgyud ldan yin na yangadag slong ba rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yinadagos par thal lo/ /dam bca' 'bad pa'i phyig 'dod na/ spang gnyen la spro ba'i nyan thos lam du 'jug kha ma chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ yang dag slong ba yin na khyod kyi nyer len du gyur pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gcig sngon du song bas khyab par thal/ 'grel pa las/ de'i 'og tu zhugs pa la brtson 'grus 'byung bas/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ nyer len byed pa'i don ma yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyis dran pa nyer bzhag shes rab dngan yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus su 'dod pa'i phyig khyab ste/ shes rab dang de gnyis rdzas rgyun mi gcig pa'i phyid gzhan yang / lam ma zhugs na byang phyogs so 70
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/bdun sgom pa med par thal/ de sgom pa'i myong ba cig car skyes pa med pa'i pyid ma grub na/ sde tshanadang po gsum la myong ba cig car thon pa zhig yod par thal lo/ /ma grub pade'i mig 'dod na/ de gsum cig car skyes pazungad par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyidgnyis pa rang lugs la/ spang gnyen gyi blang dor la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i mkhyen pa de/ yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ mdzod las/ brtson 'grus yang dag 'jog ces sga /zhes dang / kun btus las kyang] ngo bo nyid gang zhe na brtson 'grus sbyo/ shā/ rnyigh+nā shārnyirnyi dz+nyo /sna bzlo shāshā/snra ༵ r+sha/ (( dede/dz+nyo pa~X dī gā /ji dī /shā /shā dang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid dbye na bzhi yodade/ midage ba skyes pa spong ba'ide/ ma skyes pa mi skyed pa'ide dang/ dge ba skyes pa 〉la ba'i de dang/ ma skyes pa skyed pa'ilangadag slong ba bzhiwend pa'i mig 'grel pa las/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la mi dge ba dang dge ba skyes padang ma skyes padag go rim bzhin duyangadag par spong bdang/ mi skyed pa dang] srel ba dang / skyed pa'i rgyu'i brtson 'grus yang dag par spong ba'i rnam pa bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid sa mtshams tshogs lam chung ngun yod/ sgom tshula'adzid de/ rgyu 'dun padang/gnyin po 'bad pa zhi gnas dang rab 'dzinadang btang snyoms sgom pa'i sgonasayin pa'i phyig mdo las/ 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jog go/zhes bzhi ka la gsungs pa'i phyisgsum pa rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ de la cha bzhag mi 'thad par thal/ de la brtson 'grus kyis khyab pa'i phyirate/ kun btus lasango bo nyid gang zhen/ brtson 'grus so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi yang dag spong ba ngos bzung ba yin pa'i phyis 'dod na/ de dang 71
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyig rtags grub ste/ grogs yang dag spong ba dang 'tshel ba'ilangadag spong bawend pa'i pyidgsum pa ni/ 'grel pa las/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyingang ba'i lam la 'dun pa dang /nas/ ② 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i rnam pa bzhi'o/ /zhes byung / sbyordzor ba dang mtha' dbyad pa gnyis/dang 4 ni/ shes bya chos can/ de'i 'og tu rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ spang gnyen la blang dor byed pa'i brtson 'grus kyi 'bras bu shin sbyangs kyis sems las su rung bar byed pa'i phyir/ mtha' dpyad la gsum las/ dang 4 la kho na re/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por slong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'odzin de/ ② 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ lam ma zhugs gang zag gi rgyud kyi zhi gnas sgrub dus kyi de chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig 'dod na/ lam yin par thal lo/ /yang kha cig /nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por slong pa'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags sla/'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na nyes pa lnga spong pa'i 'du byed brgyad yod par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de na sgom med pa'i sgyid gzhan yang / nyes pa lnga dang bral ba'i tshe yang 'du byed brgyad ka sgom dgos par thal/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba la 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gshor gsum/ tshig sbyo tsam mo/ /'dod na/ de'i bying rgod kyi gnyen po 'du byed pa dgos par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i pyir/ medod na/ dbus mtha' las/ zhi tshe rnal du 'jug pa'o/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ sems mnyam pa nyid du 'jug par 'gyur ba'i tshe 'du byed pa'am rtsol na skyon yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ sgom rim phyi ma gnyis las/ gal te sems mnyam par zhugs pa la rtsol ba byas na de'i tshe rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur 72
