thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/de skyed pa la rang dbang can gyi lam yin pa'i pyid 'dod na/ rtsabad gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang / /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i sgyid yang kha cig gis/ 'di'i rnam byang dbang 4 la sems byung dgos zer ba dang / yang kha cig /ngo bo nyid kyi dbang po la yang sems dang sems byung gzhan 'dod zer na/ dang po de khegs la phyi ma yang mi 'thad par thal/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnam byang dbang 4 la sems byung lngar nges pa'i phyir/ kun btus las/ ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge bedzin dang / shes rab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ so bdun rdzas bcur nges pa de'i phyir/ yang kha cig /lam ma zhugs na dad sogs dbang po lnga yod par thal/ de na dad pa dang brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab lnga yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ dbang por 'jog pa la nyon mongs gnon cing lam la dbang byed pa dgos pa'i phyis mdzod las/ rnam par byang la dbang byed phyis /dad sogs dbang po lngar 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigrang lugs la/ rang yul bden pa la yid ches sogs kyis dbang byed pa'i dad rtsogs lnga gtso sor gyur pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mkhyen pa de/ byang phyogs nang tshan gyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid yin te/ kun btus las/ dbang po rnams kyi dmigs pa gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi 4 rnams sesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid dbye na lnga lte/ kun btus las/ ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgom tshul 〈snad de/ bden pa rnams la yid ches pa'i dad pa bskyed nas brtson pa dang dran pa dang ting nge bedzin 'byung zhing sgom pa'i go rim yang de yin no/ /sgra don yod de/ 'phags lam 'grub pa'i bdag khor gyur pas na dbang po zhes brjod pa'i phyis 'grel chen las/ 'phags lam 'grub pa'i bdag 〈snar gyur pas zhes zung/ /75
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/rtsod spong la kho na re/ lam ma zhugs nadad pa mi ldog pa med par thal/ de nadad pa'i dbang po med pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya zeg chen rigs nges dbang rnon lam la 'jug kha ma'i rgyud kyi de yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid de la lam zhugs kyis ma khyab pa'i phyislnga pa ni/ 'grel pa las/ mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lam la bzod pa dang chos mtshog gi ngo bo nyid dad pa dang / zhes sogs byung / spyor ba ni shes bya chos can/ de'i 'og tu mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'i lam stobs lnga bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ drod rtse'i dad sogs las bzod mchog gi stobs lnga 'byung ba'i pyir/ mtha' dbyad pa la kha cig na re/ dad sogs kyi dbang po yin na/ dad sogs kyi stobs yin pas khyab zer na/ drod rtse'i gnas skabs kyi dad sogs chos can/ stobs yin par thal/ dad sogs kyi dbang 4 yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/rjes thob tu yang mi mthun phyogs ma dad pa sogs mi 'byung bar thal/ stobs yin pa'i phyir/khyab lte/ dad sogs dbang 4 lnga'i mnyam bzhag tu ma dad pa sogs mi 'byung yang rjes thob tu 'byung bas srel ma dang stobs kyi dus mnyam rjes gang du mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dang po grub lte/'grel chen las/ ma dad pa la 〈snags pa'i mi mthun phyogs dang / dad pa la serdzogs pa'i gnyen ṭo gnyis su 'dres par 'byung ba ni dbang po zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ 'grel chen las/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis ma 'dres par gnyen 4 'ba' zhig 'byung ba ni stobs zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid kha cig 'di la 'khral nas dad dbang la de 'dra bas khyab zer na/ rgyur lam bzod pa ba'i stong nyid la yid ches chos can/ de 'dra bar thal/ dad pa'i dbang 4 yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dad pa'i stobs yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/de'i rgyud kyi yang dbang sho yin la stobs ma yin pa yod pas skyon med zer na/ de 'dra yod kyang 76
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/de mi 'thad par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi de gnyis mi 'gal ba'i phyig gzhan yang / sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi dad dbang 'phen no/ /'di ni rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta'i rtsod tshul lo/ /rang lugs la rang gi mi mthun phyogs mngon gyur pa bcom pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i bzod pa yan chad kyi dad sogs gang rung gi mkhyen pa de/ byang phyogs kyi stobs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ kun btus las/ dbang 4 rnams ji lta bar stobs rnams la'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ kun btus las/ 'di ni bye brag yin te/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs nges par srab pas mi rdzi ba'i phyir stobs rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ dbye ba ni lnga yod/ so so'i ngo bo yod de/ byang chub la dad pa sogs yin pa'i phyig rgyan gyi 'grel pa la sa/dad pa'i dbang po'i gzhi ni byang chub ste dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang ༵ spra dzong k+ṣiṃ spra rlond ༵ /ts+tsha r+yaṃ / /shā r+sha snaX 〉nga r+ṇi spri ṭ+wāṃ krā ji ༷/ ṭā lha/ smra lhashā mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig sgom tshul 'dra/ stobs zhes bya ste/ gnyen po stobs dang ldan pas mi mthun phyogs mngon du gyur pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir te/ dbus mtha' las/ mi mthun phyongags ni srab pa'i phyir/ /stobs ldan 'bras bu phyi ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisdrug pa ni/ 'grel pa las/ mngon par rtogs ba'i lam la dran pa dang / zhes sogs byung /sbyongar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ stobs kyi rjes su mngon rtogs kyi lam byang chub kyi yan lag bdun bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ drod sogs kyis bden bzhi rtogs shing sgom pas mthong lam gyi ngo 4ra gyur pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/ mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig na re/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mthar thug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa de/ byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/77
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden bzhi'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i de yin par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang nyan thos dang byang sems mthong lam rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi rtog bar gyur pa'i lam rnams chos can/ der thal/ byang chub yan lag yin pa'i phyig༵༵ dī gā ༈ gh+nā spra/ pa/ spra dī spyu k+ṣiṃ ༵ gh+nāsna r+shapa shā/ ༵ ༈ /dalha gārdzu papa chu/ tsho ga hā/ (lha yin pas rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid yin par lta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/'das lam gyi dran sogs rtog bral dang / 'jig rten pa'i dran sogs rtog pa gnyis yod pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ byang chub thob byed kyi thabs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig rtags grub ste/ nyan thos kyi byang chub zob byed kyi thabs yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ 'phags lam du thal 'o(/ /yang kha cig/de yin na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gang rung gi byang chub kyi rgyu yin pas khyab zer na/ mthong lam pa'i dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byang chub rtag pa yin pa'i phyig sa sde las/ byang chub ni gnyis te/ spangs pa dngakartogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyidpa'i ma~X pa/ pa gh+nā /ga/ k+to ༵༵ r+sha pa sdi rto/lha rdzu rnyi dz+nyo ༵ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ /sbyo k+ṣiṃ ༵/ pa/ rnyi pasnrosna nyid yin te/ mdo lde rgyan las/ sar zhugs pa la byang chub kyi/ /yan lag rnam par bzhag pa brjod/ /chos rnams dang ni sems can kun/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyidade la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yodade dran payangadag byang chub kyi yan lag/chos rab tu rnam 'byod yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag78
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/shin sbyangs yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yod pa'i pyig shes rab ni rang bzhin gyi yan lag dran pa gnas kyi dang] brtson 'grus nges 'byung gi dang / dga' ba phan yon gyi yan lag dang / shin sbyangs ting nge 'dzin btang snyoms gsum nyon lngasnangs med pa'i yan lag yin pa'i pyid dbus mtha' las/ rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag/gsum pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ /bzhi pa phan 'aman yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon snang(shā rdzu shā ༵ sprad/dz+nyo sbri ༵ ༵ ༵ tram̐ shur+shaX pyo n+dhasna ā ( shārnyi ṇ+ṭhī lhang ༵ shā/ dang] brtson pas chos snang nor bu lta bu dngan dga' bas sa lam bzod myur rta mchog ltabu dngakashin sbyangs kyis bde ba btsun mo lta bu/ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gyor kun skyed pa khyim bdag lta bu/btang snyoms kyis 'dor len blon po ltar byed pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ rtag tu rin chen bdun lta bu'i/ /byang chub yan lag rnams kyis bskod /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis sgra bshad yod de/ zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag ste/ rgyu yin pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyid dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad las/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de la dran pa la sogs pa bdun ni byang chub dang mthun pa'i phyir de'i yan lag rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbdun pa ni/ 'grel pa las/ rnam par dag pa nges par 'byin pa'i lam la yang dag pa'i lta ba dang] zhes sogs byung/ bh+yor ba ni de'i 'og tu nges 'byon gyi lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yodade/mthong lam du yan lag bdun sgom pa las sgom lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad 'byung ba'i pyid mtha'adapyad pa la kha cigan re/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du 79
phar phyin skabs bzhi nga//mthong zin sgom par byed pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pade/ 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid ༷dī /sa/ ༵ kau na rdo snrirnyi /snga(shā rnyi dz+nyo r+shaX lha// r+shahā tshoXde ༵ /rdzu /ra/rdo spya spra ༵ hāswā du gsar rtogs yin pa'i pyid gzhanayang] 'phags lam yan lag la rtog par gyur pa'i dedang rtog med kyi de gnyis med par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ byang chub yan lag la 'dzig rten pa'i byang chubayan lag rtog par gyur pa'i lamadang 'das lam rtog bral sgya lam āX dwo nāpa hā shā/ dz+nyo ༵༵༵ dzī snaX mi (sna /sna pa/ shāsdi parnyi lhag/ sna (1 dz+nyo sdi parnyi bar bya'o/ /gangadag 'jig rten las 'das pade dgani yang dag pa'i shes pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ 'grel pa las lam sgya yan lag sgom lam la sbyar ba mi 'thad par thal/mthong lam na lam gyi yan lag brgyad bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ yan lag brgyad pode mthong lam du blo brtan gyis kyang bzhag pa'i phyid gser 'phreng las/de ltanayang mthong lam du bzhag pa mi 'gal te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ dbyig gnyin gyis kyang de ltar bshad pa'i phyir te/ dbus mtha'i 'grel pa las/ yangadag pa'i ltab ni sgom pa'i lam gyi tshe mthong ba'i lam la yongs su gcod pa'ilan lag ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigayang kha cig /sgom spangadag par bya ba'i phyirares par 'byin pa'i sgom lam de/ lam gyi yan lag de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig 'phags lam yin pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus/ 'de ladabyad rgyu mang yang yi ge mang dogs so/ /rang lugs la/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mkhyen pa de/'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na lam gyi yan lag brgyad yod de/ slob pa'i dbang 80
thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun/du byas na mnyam bzhag tu chos nyid rtogs pa rjes thob tu dpyod pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang /de dang mdo don gzhan la ston byed kyi rtog pa dang / rdzun sogs dag pa'i ngag dang / lus/ kyi las dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / lus skya tshul 'a〈snas ngag gi kha gsag dag pa'i yang dag 'tsho ba dang / sgom spang spangs pa'i rtsol ba dang / zhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan gsum mi brjed pa'i dīnā pa ༵go / ༵ (sna snokāsna snrodhi dzo /shā zi ḍā /sgri ( dz+nyo sna 'i ñcha ṇā/ spri) k+ta/ dī dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhes /lha shā rnyi sbyod sdidī/ sdusdi r+sha pa/ ni /nga/ lta/ ༵ spra snangapa'i dri pa~X spras traṃ snang/ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ lha ༵༷ gzhan yid ches pa'i yan lag dang / lhag ma gsum gnyen po'i yan lag dang bzhir 'du ba'i phyir/ dbus mtha' las/ yongs su gcod dang go byed dang / /rnam gsum gzhan yid ches par byed/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen por ni/ /lam gyi yan lag de brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis sgra bshad yod de/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi gzhir gyur pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyisrtsod spong la kho na re/ phyi ma gsum la nyon mongs spong byed kyi slob lam gyis khyab par thal/ de gsum rim bzhin du nyon mongs dang /nye nyon bying rgod dang / dbang gi mi mthun phyogs gsum spong byed kyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ dbus mtha' las/ nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dbang / /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ byang sems kyi de'i dbang du byas pa'i nyid rgyan 'grel las/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba la 〈snags pa ni bosna rim bzhin du shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / lam gyi sgrib pa dang / yon tan khyad par can gyi sgrib pa'i gnyen 81
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/por sgom pa ste/ yun ring por mi skyo bar shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por sgom par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di gzhi shes skabs yin pas/ 'grel pa las kyang thun mong tsam bshad kyang byang sems kyi byang phyogs thun mong ma yin pa shes ched du mdo dang rgyan gyi don cung zad bris te rgyas par shes sdud/ /smras pa/theg gsum byang chub phyogs mthun 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /thos bsam 'od stong shar bas rab bzhad pa'i/ /legs bshad dri bsung sa gsum yongs khyab pa'i/ /mngon par rtogs pa ma 'dres ri mo bkra/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /82
