phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dris pa bco brgyad dang / de bzhin nyid kyi shes rnam/ rang byung gi shes rnam dang / sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar yod pa de'i pyid mtha' dbyad pa la kha cig na re/thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin na sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pas khyab zer na/ 'o na/ ji lta ba rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs yin par thal/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyig der thal/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa la don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis yod pas shes rnam yin pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ yul can gyi dbang du byas na sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems skya rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i migsangs rgyas sa na nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang / rang rgyal gyi de/ byang sems kyi de gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/yang kha cig /'di'i de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa de rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa so dgu'i gcig la tsan zer na/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi chos nyid chos can/ der thal/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sangs rgyas kyi zugs rgyud kyi chos nyid chos can/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid du lasdog zer na/ 'o na/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs chos can/ thun mong ba'i der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i 100
thun mong ma yin pa'i so dgu/rigs 'dra snga ma 'phags pa 'og ma byang 'phags kyi rgyud la yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i nyer len byang 'phags kyi rgyud la yod pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i de yin pa'i phyid'dod na/ stobs bcu thun mong ma yin pa'i de ma yin par thal lo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi chos can/ rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la med par thal/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyig der thal/ shun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa so dgu po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag sum cu rtsadagu dag tu bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyis khyab nye/ nyi snang las/ de ltar na go rim bzhin du bcu dang] bzhi dang] bzhi dang / bco brgyad dang / gcig dang / gcig dang] gcig ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la brten pa'i rnam pa sum cu rtsadagur bshad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid rtsabar 'dod na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ sesna rtso yang dag rig pa bzhi rjes su mthun pa sa dgu pa nas thob pa'i phyir te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ so so yang dag rig blo bzang / /sa de legs pa'i slo gros yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis rgyan gyi yang yin no/ /yang kha cig na re/ rang gi ngos skal gyi mi mthun phyogs 'groms pa la lha'i dbang po'i rdo rje rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de/ 'dir bstan stobs kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi stobs bcu chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/'dir bstan stobs yin pa'i phyis khyab pa khas/ 'dod na rang gi ngos skal gyi mi mthun phyogs yod par thal/ gdod pa'i phyig 'dod na/ khyod kyi ngos skal gyi mi mthun phyogs med par thal/khyod mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag spangs zin pa'i rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/lubor gyi dbus su nga ni chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas dren zhes dam bcas pa la 〈snas mthun gyi thestol ba med pas mi 'jigs pa'i ye shes mthar 101
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/thug de/ 'der bstan mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi gzhi shes su gyur pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi chos can/ 'dir bstan mi 'jigs pa yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig der thal/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i mig 'dod na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par thal/ 'dod pa'i mig 'dod mi nus te/ gzhi shes yin pa'i pyig yang kha cig na re/'chad bya 'chad byed kyi slobs pa so sor ma 'dris pa'i mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ so so yang dag rig pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i gzhi shes dang / phyi don med par rtogs pa'i gzhi shes re re nas chos can/ so so yang dag rig pa yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden gnyis las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis kyangaka /shes bya'i dkyil gargar kun khyab can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod na/ zun mong ma yin pa'i der thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/shun mong gi de yin pa'i phyis der thal/ sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ chos gsor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mthar zug gi mkhyen pa/ rang byung gi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ rang byung gi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyal dgra bcom yin pa'i pyid mdzod las/ gshor los sgyur dang rang byung gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus/ yang kha cig na re/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par mthar zug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs 'phags kyi mig shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyis rtags grub ste/ sangs rgyas yin pa'i mig 'dod na/ lam yin par thal lo/ /rang lugs la/ rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa de/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ dper 102
thun mong ma yin pa'i sodagu/na/ sangs 'phugs rgyud kyi gzhi shes so bdunadang nyer bdun ltabu/ rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pade/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ thun mong ba dang de ma yin pa'i don rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa dang med pa'i cha nas lasdog dbye na/ stobs brga mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ sesna serdzo yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid kyi shes rnam/ rang byung gi shes rnam/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi shes rnam dang sde tshan bdun rngamad/ chos thams cad chags thogs med par rtogs la/ mi mthun phyogs las rgyal zhing] de dag gis brdzi mi nus pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mkhyen pa de/ stobs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ sgra don yang de yin pa'i phyir te/ gser 'tsheng las/ de dag kyang mi mthun phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing de dag gis mi rdzi bas stobs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig dbye na/ bcu yod de/'grel pa las/ de la gnas dang gnas min pa dang] nas/ stobs kyi rnam pa bcu dang zhes so/ /lurgar gyi nang du spangs rtogs kyi chos ston pa la mi 'jigs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mthar zug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ mi 'dzigs pa'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang don phun tshogs kyi gnyis dang / gzhan don phun tshogs kyi gnyis dang bzhi yod/ 'grel pa las/ nga ni sangs rgyas so zhes bdag nyid zhal gyis 'ches pa dang / zhes sogs byungaka 'chad bya 'chad byed kyi slobs pa so sor chags 'ogs med par mngon sum du gzigs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mthar zug gi lam de/ so so yang dag rig pa'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ chos dang / don dang / nges tshig dang / spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa bzhi yod de/ 'grel pa las/ rnam grangs dang chos kyi mtshan nyid/ sogs byung / rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma dang cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i mthar zug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi 〈snas ma 'dres 103
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bco brgyad yod de/ rtogs pa ma 'dris pa drugsprungad pa ma 'dris pa drug 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum dang bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa las/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dris pa bco brgyad kyi rnam pa dag dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de kho na nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de/ de bzhin nyid kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dngos bstan la yul yul can gyi gnyis yod kyang 'dir mkhyen pa'i dbang du byas te/ 'grel pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyid slob dasan gzhan la ma stos pa'i rang byung gis chos thams cad la mnga' bsgyur ba'i ye shes de/ rang byung gi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ lung las/ nyer 'gro nga ni sangs rgyas te/ /nga la slob dpon su yang med/ /ces gsungs pa'i pyid skabs 'di'i rang byung la gnyis yod de/ yul chos nyid dang] yul can ye shes gnyis yod pa'i pyir te/ gser 'phreng las/ rang byung yang gnyis te/ chos kyidabyings dang]srid pa tha ma bas shes bya thams cad mngon du byas pa'i ye shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis de gnyis kyi dang po de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa dang 'dir rang byung gi ye shes 'odzin dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ chos thams cad la mnga' bsgyur ba'i rang byung dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyigkhyab ste/ gser 'phreng las/ dang po ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid yin pas 'der gnyis pa bzung ngos /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid chos thams cad kyi rnam pa ma lus par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gnas bzhag pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa de/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ 'grel pa las/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa gsum lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyidrtsod slong la kha cig /rnam mkhyen chos can/ rang byung yin par thal/ rang byung gi ye shes 104
thun mong ma yin pa'i so dgu/yin pa'i pyid gdod na/ 'dod rgyal du byung bar thal/ rang byung yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rang byung gnyis yod pa'i phyig yang kho na re/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas par thal chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ 'o na/ yang dag par sangs rgyas yod par thal/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ yang dag par grub pa yod par thal lo/ /yang kha cig na re/ sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol bar thal/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi stobs bcu po de gdul bya'i rgyud kyi mi mthun phyogs 'joms byed yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ de 'joms pa la lha'i dbang po'i rdo rje dang mtshungs pa'i pyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ stobs rnams ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid'grel pa las/ 'das pa dang] ma 'ongs pa dang] da ltar byung ba la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa gsum ste/ zhes pa'i skabs su mtha' dpyad pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po la bye smra'i btsun pa chos skyob dngos po gzhan du 'gyur ba smra ba yin te/ des myu gu ma 'ongs panas da ltar ba dang/ da ltar ba nas 'das par 'jug pa na/ ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba'i dngos 4 'dor gyi ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba'i rdzas mi lagar bar gdod pa'i phyid dper na/gser gyi snod bcom nas rgyan byed pan dbyibs 'dor kyang kha dog mi 'gyur ba bzhinan/ /zhes zeg btsun pa dbyangs sgrogs ni mtshan nyid 'gyur ba smra ba yin te/ des dus re re yang dus gsum lnga'i mtshan nyid dang ldan kyang gang shas che ba'i sgo nas 'jog par 'dod pa'i pyid btsun pa dbyig bshes ni gnas skabs 'gyur ba smra ba yin te/ myu gu sesnags dngos 4 gcig kyang ma 'ongs spru la sogs pa'i gnas skabs so sor phyin pa ma 'ongs pa la sogs par 'jog par khas len pa'i phyid btsun pa sangs rgyas lha rang bzhin gzhan 'gyur smra ba yin te/ bud med gcig 105
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/stos sa rtso so la stos nas mdang bu mor brjod pa ltar dngos po gcig kyang snga ma la stos nas ma 'ongs pa dang pyi ma la ltos nas 'das par 'jog ces khas len pa'i pyir te/ mdzod las/ rnam bzhi dngos dang mtshan nyid dang / /gnas skabs gzhan gzhan 'gyur zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bzhi mi 'thad par thal/ dang 4 grangs can gyi lugs dang / gnyis pa mtshan nyid 'chol ba'i skyon dang / gsum pa la bya ba byed mi byed kyi gnas skabs med pa'i skyon dang / bzhi pa la dus 'tshol ba'i skyon 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de bzhi mi 'thad par thal/ 'das ma 'ongs dus myu gu'ingo 4cand na myu gu zhig pa dang skye ba mi 'thad pa'i pyid yang kha cig na re/ ṣ+kamngon/skyes la 'gag pa 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ skye ba'i rgyu yod kyang ma byung ba ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ skyes la ma 'gag pa da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/ dus gsum dngos ṭo yin te/ dngos 4 yin na da ltar ba yin mi dgos pa'i gyid ma grub na/ 'das pa'i dngos 4 chos can/ da ltar ba yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i nyid 'dod na/ 'das pa'i dngos po ma yin par thal/ da ltar ba'i dngos 4 yin pa'i phyir sogs dang / rgyal po glang dar 'das pa dang / lha lung dpal rdor gyis bsad pa yin zeg mang bkur ba 'das pa dang / rgyal po dung ma 'ongs pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ 'das dang ma 'ongs brjod bya min/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pag dper na/ rgyal po chen 4 mang pos bkur ba byung bar gyur pa dang/ rgyal 4 dung gshor los sgyur ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid ma 'ongs pa ston pa na/ mngon pa las/ rgyu 〈snad kyang/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir sogs ltar snang mang po smra'o/ /'o na/ 'das pa chos can/ 'das pa'i 'bras bu yin par thal/ 'das pa dang 'bras bu'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyig khyab pa khas/ gabor gsum yang khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod khyod kyi 'bus bu ma yin par thal/ khyod khyod dang tha dad ma yin pa'i phyig gangor gsum/ glang dar ma chos can/ yod par thal/ gsad bya yin pa'i pyid106
thun mong ma yin pa'i so dgu/rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ med par thal/ lha lung dpal rdor gyis med par byas pa'i phyis gshor gsum khas/ lha'or sgyur dung chos can/ gsor los sgyur btsan par thal ma 'ongs pa dang lubor sgyur gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i nyid 'dod na/ de chos can/ skyes par thal/ gshor sgyur yin pa'i phyis 'dod na/ skye ba'i rgyu yod kyang ma byung ba yin par thal/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gtor gsum khas/ gzhan yang / dus gsum langog tshe myu gu lta bu rang gi dus la ltos k+ṣiṃ zlosa~X shā d+mo snyiX /gopa dṛ )(( da/ n+d+ra k+ṣiṃ ñcā sbyi pya /lha spras rnyiXnā ñcā spyan sprijipa phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ skal bzang mig 'byed las/ myu gu da ltar ba yin min ni myu gu'i rang dus la ltos nas rtsidagos pa yin gyi/ dus kyi dgag sgrub byed pa po'i gang zag de'i ngag brjod bzhin pa'i dus na myu gu med pas myu gu da ltar ba ma yin par 'jog pa min te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di ltar ma go nas/ da lta'ang sna tshogs smras so/ /yang kha cig /'das pa la zhig pa dang ma 'ongs pa la ma skyes pas khyab par khas len cing rgyu sngar yod dang / 'bras bu phyis 'byung du 'dod bzhin du skad cig snga ma rnams 'das pa dang skad cig phyi ma rnams ma 'ongs par smra ba ni nang 'gal te/ 'o na/ bum pa skad cig thog mtha' bar gsum gyi skad cig dang po'i bum pa chos can/ zhig pa yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bum pa'i skad cig snga ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ chos can de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dngos po yin na rang dus cha gsum yod pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ ji srid skad cig mtha' yod pa/ /de srid zog mtha' dbus brtags dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zhig pa ma yin par thal/ bum pa yin pa'i phyir/rtags sla/ ma khyab na/ de chos can/ skyes la ma 'gag pa'i dngos 4 ma yin par thal/ da ltar ba 107
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/ma yin pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ rgyu yin pa'i phyig der thal/ bum pa'i skad cig gsum gyi snga ma yin pa'i pyid gzhan yang / de 'dra ba'i skad cig gsum pa'i bum pa chos can/ ma skyes par thal/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i sgyir/ der thal/ bum pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi pyi ma yin pa'i phyig khyab pa khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'bras bu yin pa'i phyig de'i skad cig snga ma'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i skad cig phyi ma yin pa'i pyid yang kha cig /skyes la 'gag pa de 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu yod la ma skyes pa de ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ skyes la ma 'gag pa de da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'das pa chos can/ khyod yin na byas pas khyab par thal/ khyod yin na skyes pas khyab pa'i phyig 'dod na/ bum pa zhig pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ med dgag yin pa'i pyid ma grub na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod zhig pa dang khyod 'das pa med dgag yin par thal/ khyod dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang] ma 'ongs pa chos can/khyod yin na 'bus bu yin dgos par thal/ khyod yin na khyod kyi rgyu yod dgos pa'i phyig 'dod na/ bum pa ma 'ongs pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i sgyid 'dod me nus te/ med dgag yin pa'i phyig ma grub na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod ma 'ongs pa med dgag yin par thal/ khyod dngos so yin pa'i mig yang kha cig /sngar yod 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ phyis 'byung ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ rgyu la 'das pas khyab pa dang / 'bras bu la ma 'ongs pas khyab par thal/mtshan nyid gnyis 'thad pa gang zhig /rgyu sngar yod dang 'bras bu phyis 'byung yang yin pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ da ltar ba mi srid par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig /dngos 4 yin na khyod kyi skye gnas 'jig gsum dus mnyam du grub pas khyab zer na/ myu gu chos can/ der thal/de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ myu gu skye ba'i dus yin na de 'dzig pa dang gnas pa'i dus yin pas khyab par thal/ de gsum dus gcig pa'i phyis gdod na/ myu gu'i dngos rgyu'i dus chos can/ myu gu'i 108
thun mong ma yin pa'i so dgu/gnas dus dang 'jig dus yin par thal/ myu gu'i skye ba'i dus yin pa'i pyid der thal/ rang gi dngos rgyu'i dus dang rang dus gang rung du skye/ rang dus su mi skye ba'i phyig dang 4 grub ste/de skye ba'i phyig gnyis pa grub lte/ de'i rang dus su rang gi rgyu med pa'i phyis rtsabar 'dod na/myu gu'i dngos rgyu chos can/ khyod kyi dus su myu gu yod par thal/ khyod kyi dus su myu gu gnas pa'i phyig rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi dus su de skye bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'jug pa las/ skye bzhin pa ni skye la phyogs pas 〈snad min zhing / /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidgzhan yang dngos 4 la rang gi skye gnas 'jig pa'i dus gsum cig car grub pas ma khyab par thal/ dngos bo la rang gi skye gnas 'jig pa'i dus gsum rim can du grub pas khyab pa'i phyis der thal/ dngos po la rang gi dngos rgyu'i dus de rang gi skye dus dang] rang grub pa'i dus de rang gi gnas dus dang / rang dus skad cig gnyis pa'i dus de rang gi 'jig dus yin pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ de rang dus skye dus ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang dus su skyes zin pa'i pyig gnyis pa grub lte/ rang dus dang rang gi gnas dus don gcig pa'i pyir te/ de gnyis yod pa'i phyid gsum pa grub ste/ rang gi 'gag dus dang rang gi 'jig dus don gcig pa'i phyir te/de 'jig pa la mngon du phyogs dus thams cad de 'jig dus la khas len mi rigs pa'i phyir/spros pas tshog go/paṇ+ḍi ta kha cig na re/ phuga'adus byas thams cad skad cig ma yin pas dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig las mi sdod zer na/'o na/ 47 chos can/ dus mtha'i skad cig las mi sdod par thal/ skad cig ma yin pa'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ 'dus byas yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ de chos can/ lo ma yin par thal/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma yin pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ zla ba bcu gnyis kyis bzhag pa'i bgrang gzhi yin pa'i sgyig khyab ste/ lo dang/ yong bgrang dang] bgrang gzhi dang] medor byed rnams lo'i rnam grangs yin pa'i pyid 'chi med mdzod 109
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/las/ lo dang yong bgrang bgrang gzhi dang / /'gro 'ong dang ni 'dor byed de/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid byas pa la kho na re/ ma khyab par thal/ zla ba bcu gnyis rdzogs ma thag dang 'og grub ma thag dus mnya5 par kho 'os 'dod pa'i phyir na/ rab byung gi zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig grub ma thag dang rab byung gi lo grub ma thag dus mi mnyam par thal/ rab byung gi zla ba bcu gnyis rdzogs ma thag de de grub dus yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rab byung gi lo chos can/ rab byung gi brtsigazhi zla ba bcu gnyis kyi yun ring zung can ma yin par thal/ rab byung gi zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig gi dus na khyod ma grub pa'i phyis khyab ste/ lo 3 grub dus dang 'gag dus mi gcig pa'i pyig rnam bshad rigs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ lo rdzogs pa la zla ba bcu gnyis rdzogs dgos shing/ de'i 'og tu lode mi gnas pas rgyun thams cad kyang rang grub pa'i dus las dus gnyis par mi sdod pa'i skad cig ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigrang lugs la/ dus gsum dang/ de mkhyen tshul la dogs gcod gnyis/ skyes zin slar 'gag pa'i cha de/ 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi myu gu 'das pa lta bu lte/ skal bzang mig 'byod las/ rgyu las skyes zin pa'i dngos po de nyid slar zhig pa dang / zhes dang / rigs rgyan dang sde bdun rgyan las so/ /chos de'i rgyu yod kyang yul dus 'ga' zhig tu ma skye ba'i cha de/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi myu gu skyed byed kyi rkyen ma tshang bas ma skyes pa lta bu yin te/skal bzang mig 'byed las/ dngos po de nyid kyi rgyu yod kyang da lta dngos po de ma skyes pa dang /zhes 〈sna/ /skyes pa dang ma zhig pa'i gzhi mthun de da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi myu gu lta bu yin te/ skal bzang mig 'byed las/ skyes la ma 'gag pa/ zhes dreg/ /dus gsum dren so'i mtshan nyidade ltar gdod pa dang/ zos ma 'ongs gnyis med dgag dang/ dngos med du 'dod pa la mdo sems dbu ma rang rgyud pa gsum mthun pa'i phyir te/ skal bzang mig 'byed las/ dus 110
thun mong ma yin pa'i sodagu/gsum gyi mtshan nyid 7do ltar du 'dod pa dang/ 'das ma 'ongs yin na dngos bor med pas khyab par khas len pa la mdo lde pa dang sems tsam padangadabu ma rang rgyud pa gsum ka khyad par med cing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyig da ltar gyi rnam mkhyen gyis dus gsum thams cad cig car du rtogs te/ skad cig gis dus thams cad kyi byung tshul mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i phyir te/ 'das pa'i byung tshul thams cad kyang dus de dang der byung tshul da lta skad cig la mkhyen kyang da ltar byung bar mkhyen pa ma yin la/ de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang 'dra bas dus gsum ma 'dres par mkhyen pa dang / cig car mkhyen pa gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsod spong la kho na re/ mang bkur ba 'das pa'i mi yin par thal/ 'das pa'i mi yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'das pa'i n+ma dran tshul yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de ni dran mkhan de'i dus su 'das pa dran tshul tsam yin pa'i phyig khyab lte/ de tsam gyis 'das par mi 'jog pa'i phyir/ma grub na/ sang nyin chos can/ 'das pa yin par thal/ gnangs dus de ltar dran pa yod pa'i phyir te/ 'khor gsum/ e shes/ yang kha cig /bum pa zhig pa lngastos can/ khyod bum pa 'das par thal/ khyod bum pa zhig cha yin pa'i pyid rtags grub ste/ de zhig cha yin pa 'tshad pa'i mig'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod bum pa'i dus su 'das par thal/ khyod bum pa 'das pa yin pa'i pyir na ma khyab ste/ khyod bum pa'i dus su ma 'ongs pa'i phyir te/ khyod bum pa thal zin de yin pa'i pyid bum pa'i rgyu yod kyang rkyen dbang gis dus der ma skyes pa'i cha chos can/ khyod bum pa ma 'ongs pa yin par thal/ khyod bum pa la rgyu yod kyang rkyen gyis dus der bum pa ma byung ba'i cha de yin pa'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod na/ khyod bum pa'i dus su ma 'ongs par thal/ khyod bum pa ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir na'ang 'gal khyab ste/ bum pa'i dus su de thal zin dgos pa'i phyig yang phal cher gyis dus gsum gyi mtshan nyid so sor langog la so so'i yin pa med zer 111
pharaphyinaskabasabazhipa/ wa waba mtshon sprungar tsam yang mi shes slongs pa'i dbang phyug gi rtags yin no/ /tshig 'khri ma bris te shes sla/ byung byas tshad rgyu las skyes pa la byed mi dgos te/ gzhi grub na rten 'byung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir thenags dra/byang ༵ dzohā /spya sbyi / shārnyi dī k+ṣiṃ ri/ ṭ+wāṃ pa/sna ( pa/ shā smra lha spra sde m+p+raṃ rnapa sna ṭ+wāṃ lja tshos ṭ+wāṃ dag kyang yin no/ /zhes sogs byung/ mtha' dbyad pa la kha cig na re/ rnam grangs pa'i zag bcas yin na zag bcas yin pas khyab pa dang / rnam grangs pa'i zag med yin na zag med yin pas khyab pa'i phyir zer na/ dang po la/theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ zag bcas yin par thal/ rnam grangs pa'i zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyon mongs spang bya'i gtso 'or mi byed pa'i byang sems rgyud kyi lam yin pa'i pyig khyab lte/de gtso sor mi spong bas dedang bcas par bshad pa'i phyiganyi snang las/ rnam grangs kyi zag pa dang bcas pas zas pa dang bcas pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ rin chen 'pheng ba las/ 'on kyang de ni snying rje yis/ /byang chub bar du srid mtshams sbyongad /zhes gsungs pa dang gnad gcig pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ bar chad med lam yin pa'i nyid gzhan yang/ rgyun zhugs rgyud kyi nyon mongs spong 'dod kyi bsam pa chos can/ zag med yin par thal/ rnam grangs pa'i zag med yin pa'i phyir te/ nyon sgrib gtso sar spong ba'i rgyud kyi lam yin pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de gtso bor spong ba la de'i zag med du bzhag pa'i phyig dper na/ so skye'i rgyud kyi chags med bzhin/ gser 'phreng las/ nyon mongs rnams mda'i dug dang 'dra bar slong ba'i phyir zag med do/ /zhes 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ zag bcas yin pa'i phyir te/rtog pa yin pa'i phyis rang lugs la nyan rang slob pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes rnams rnam grangs 112
sbyor ba'i snod/kyi zag med dang] byang sems rgyud kyi gzhi shes rnam grangs kyi zag bcas dang] sangs 'phags rgyud kyi gzhi shes rnams rnam pa thams cad du zag med yin no/ /smras pa/'jig lten skye dgu'i bde skyed me tog tshal/ /rab tu snang bar byed dang skye mched kyi/ /nyi ma zeg gsum mngon rtogs 'od spros pas/ /sgrib gnyis mun bsal skye 'phags dga' bde rgyas/ /sems kyi phug pa chos min phyogs su bstan/ /'khor ba'i bag chags sbrul gdug ma mthong bag /gti mug thib por gnyid pa'i blun po dag /bsam na snying rje mi skye de su zhig/ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bden 'odzin dngos su lajums byed lhor ba bshad pa la/ rten gyi gang zag dngansbyordzor ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang 4 ni/ rtsabag sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /sogs rtsa'grel byung / 'phros sbyongar mtha' dbyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ yum bar ba las/ sher phyin 'di rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang gi rna lam du grags par gyur pa de dag kyang ldon rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur ba byas pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas mang yo la bsnyen bkur ba dang /dris pa dang/ de dus sbyin sogs la spyad pa gsum gyis sher phyin gyi tshig nyan pa dang/ bsam pa dang / bsgom pa gsum gyi snod du gsungs pa'i/ dang po 'chad par/ sangs rgyas rnams la sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung / pyi ma gnyis 'chad pag sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang / /sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung / sbyongar ba ni/ byang sems tshogs lam pa dbang rnon 113
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/chos can/ khyod sher phyin la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi snod du rung ste/ sngon sangs rgyas mang 4 la bsnyen bkur ba dang / yum don dris pa dang / phyin drug nyams su blangs pa skye ba du mar byas pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyigmtha' dbyad pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la kha cig na re/ byang sems yin na sher phyin ston pa'i snod rung gis khyab zer na/ nyan thos sde pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyid rtags grub lte/ de yod pa'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ sngar bshad pa'i dman sgrib la gnas pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen la sdang ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ chos la khong khro bdag lta dang / /nas/ rang byung rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis des gnas ma bu pa'i byang sems sogs kyang khegs/ yang kha cig /sher phyin wo pa'i snod rung la bsam sgom gyi snod rung gis khyab zer na/ sngon bla ma dang sangs rgyas du ma la bsnyen bkur byas la/ yum don dri ba sogs byed ma myong ba'i gang zag de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ rtsabar/ 'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ gang zag de 'dra yin pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ rtsabar/ sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdo las kyang de gnyis so sor bshad pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ phyi nang gi bshes gnyen gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang sems de/ 'dir bstan rgyur ba bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ gzhung snga ma'i bstan don phal pa'i sems tsam pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ sems tsam par gyur pa'i sher mdo'i gdul bya phal pa yod pa'i phyig gzhan yang / nyan thos tshogs lam pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags grub lte/ nyan thos kyi sbyongar ba bsgom pa'i gang zag yin pa'i pyir/ yang kha 114
sbyor ba'i snodcig /yum nyan pa'i snod yin na/ de nyan pa'i snod rung yin pas khyab zer na/ sngon sangs rgyas sogs la ma bsten par gzhi shes skor tsam nyan pa'i nyarna thos chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/de yod pa'i sgyid pad dkar las/ mgon po de ring bdag cag ga zos gyug /byang chub dam pa yang dag bsgrags par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i mtshan nyid mi ldan pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ ji skad du gsungs pa'i rgyu las bzlog pa mi mos pa dang spong bar byed pa'i rgyus ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig yang kha cig /bh+yor ba'i snod rung la de gsum ka byas pas khyab zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ rgyur ba'i gdul bya bzhi so sor 'drin pa'i phyigder thal/ nyan pa'i snod gsum dang bsam sgom gyi snod dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ nyi snang las/de la sbyi1ra ba po ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ gser 'phreng las/ nyan pa/ len pa/ 'dzin pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidrang lugs la/ sngon sangs rgyas bsten pa dang / de las dge rtsabaskrun pa dang / theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa gsum tshang ba'i skabs 'dir bstan pa'i gdul bya de/skabs 'dir bstan pa'i yum nyan pa'i snod rung gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ lam zhugs dang lam ma zhugs rigs can gsum sogs yod de/ 'di lam ma zhugs nas bshad pa'i phyigyum las/ sher phyin 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang gron gyi rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur ba byas pa'o/ /zhes gzhan 'dra ba la/ gang gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsab bskyed pa'o/ /gang gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lam ma zhugs nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la thos bsam sgom gsum dbosnas pa sngar bshad rin pa'i phyir/ lam gyi skabs kho nar lhor ba zhabrul ba che shos so/ /khyad par de 115
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/gsum ldan pa'i byang sems de/ skabs 'di'i yum nyan pa'i snod rung gi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ 'grel pa las/ nyan pa la sogs pa'i snod sbyongar ba 4/ zhes so/ /de re re la bzhi yod de/sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur ba dang / don r+sā ba dang] sbyin sogs bcu spyad pa dngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byin gyis brlabs pa bzhis rim pa bzhin du/ nyan pa dang / tshig 'dzin pa dang/ don mi brjed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod rung bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ 'og mtha' gnyis bzhi ka la tshang dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams la sbyor/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gser 'phreng las/ sbyor zhes pa bh+yor ba po thams cad la de yod par ston pa'o/ /zhes dang / gser 'phreng las/ bzhi ka yang theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byin gyis brlabs pa rnams ni'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis rnam bshad las kyang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byin gyis rlangs pa 'og ma gsum gyi mthar yang sbyar bar bya lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsod spong la kho na re/ yum nyan pa'i snod rung la byang sems kyis khyab nga/ra thal/ rnam bshad las/ byang sems tshogs lam pa sogs gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ mtshan gzhi yin tsam ste/ zeg chen gyi zos bsam sgom gsum ma byas par byang sems kyi lam rgyud la mi skye ba'i phyig116
sbyor ba/gnyis pa sbyongar ba ni/ rtsabad gzugs la dregags la mi gnas phyig /nas/ de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas/ /zhes byung / 'phros lhor ba mtha' dpyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ yum las/ko'u shi ka byang chen sher phyin la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs la mi gnas/ zhes pa nas/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa dang sgom pa rnams la bar chad bya bar mi nus pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i sbyordzor ba nyi shu gsungs pa de bstan bcos 'dir 'chad par drangs ma thag rtsa'agrel byung / gnyis pa ni/ 'dir bstan spyor bani nyi shu yod de/ ngo bo'i sgo nas lnga dang rten gyi sgo nas brgyad/ spyor ba rdzogs pa'i sgo nas bzhi/ 'bras bu'i sgonas gnyis dang] dus kyi sgo nas gcig ste nyi shu yod pa'i phyismtha' dbyad pa la gsum/ dang po la kha cig na re/ yul yul can gzhi lam rnam gsum bden stong spros bral du rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ skabs 'der gtso bor bstan pa'i lhor ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ 'dir bstan byang sems tshogs lam chen po pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi gnas chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i pyid khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong thob pa dang theg chen gyi spyor lam drod thob pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong thob pa la de'i zhi gnas thob pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/rgyud 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par lasdoms pa shes bya lte/ /'og mar zhi gnas btsal bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ma khyab mtshams la rtags grub lte/ rnam bshad las/ stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab ni spyor lam drod man chad na med la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig ②bar medod mi nus te/ so skye'i tshogs 117
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/lam nas ji snyed pa'i lhag mthong yod/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi gnas yod kyang stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong med pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i dus nyid na stong pa nyid la yang dang yang du dpyod pa dang rtse gcig tu 'dod pa ni tshogs lam na yang 'angad pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ de 'dra ba'i bden stong mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam thob myong gi sems dpa'i rnal 'phyor de/'dir bstan gtso 'or gyur pa'i bh+yor ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ zeg chen rigs nges bh+yor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gnas pa bkag pa'i sbyongar ba chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ gnas pa bkag pa'i sbyongar ba 〈snags lhag mthong sbyongar lam nas thob pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad drangs zin to/ /'dod mi nus te/ so skye'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyig 'od snga ma rnams na re/ nyi shu'i snga ma lnga lhor ba'i rang bzhin dang gnas skabs bcu bzhi zer na/ 'o na/ spyor ba snga ma lnga'i gnas skabs bcu bzhir thal lo/ /khyad par ma phye bar gnas skabs bcu bzhir bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i spyor ba yang de lnga'i gnas skabs la spyor bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ de skrag nas sher phyin spangs te ngan song du yun ring bor lhung bas tshegs chen yun ring du bshad pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ kun tu skrag pas zin par 'gyur te der nges par ltang bas rtogs pa'i chos kyi snod ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sher mdo las/ zeg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nas/ sher sgyin zab mo 'di spangs te log par ltang bar 'gyur ba'i las yod par 'gyur ba de'i tshegs chen pos yun ring mo zhig nas/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gser 'phreng las so/ /yang kha cig /tshogs lam pa dbang rnon rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi gnas skabs kyi skrag pa kho nar bh+yor ba mi 'thad de/ 'di dbang rtul 118
sbyor ba/dang tshegs chen 4 gnyis dgos/ dbang rnon gyis rtogs sla la myur bar bshad pa'i phyid dang so grub lte/ gser 'tsheng las/ de yang de la dbang po gnyis su byas pa'i rtul po 'ba' zhig la bya ste/ 'di rgyur ba khyad par can gyi 'gal zla skrag pa de yin pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dngaka 'grel chen las kyang rgyu gsum ma tshang ba skrag par bshad pa de'i phyis 'grel chen las/rgyu gsum las bzlog pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsab chung ba dang yongs su mi r+sā ba dang sngon spyod pa dang mi ldan pa rnams/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ kumadadang 4 lnga tshogs lam dang bco lnga lhor lam nas sa bcu la bh+yor zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ tshegs chen yun ring rgyur ba theg chen spyor lam dang mi mthun pa'i phyig der thal/ de stong nyid la skrag nas spong ba gang zhig /zeg chen gyi drod stong nyid la mi skrag pa chung ngu thob pa'i phyir/ dang po grub zin/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sbyongar lam skabs su bshad zin pa'i phyisgzhan yang] de mi 'thad par thal/ snga ma lngas lhor ba sbyor skyed tshul ston/ phyi ma bco lnga spyor ba'i skye tshul la lhor ba'i phyid dang po grub ste/ lhor ba dang sa gnyis kyis yul gtan la phab pas yul can mkhyen gsum gyi yul gsum gyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i zab dka' tshad med kyi sbyongar ba gsum 'byung ba'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ gnas pa mi sbyongar ba'i sbyongar ba la mngon par brtson pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa de dag gi zab pa nyid dang / gting dpag dka' ba nyid dang /tshad med pa nyid rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ tshegs chen gyi de tshogs lam na yod/ lung bstan thob pa'i de/ phyir mi ldog pa'i de/ nges 'byung gi de/ bar chad med pa'i de bzhi kyor lam bzhi'i gnas skabs na yod/ byang chub nye ba'i de mthong lam na yod/ sangs rgyas myur ba'i de ma dag sa bdun na yod/ gzhan don gyi de/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i de/ chos chos min sdudags mi mthong ba'i de/ bsam mi khyab kyi de/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i 119
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/de lnga sa brgyad pa na yod/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed kyi de sa dgu pa na yod/ nyes sel dag pa'i de sa bcu pa na yod/ sa mtshams bh+yor ba tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar du yod pa'i mig dang 4 grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ mi skrag pa ni lung bstan thob pa dang tshogs lam pa dbang rnon dang drod nas te/ zhes dang / phyir mi ldog pa nyid dang 'di rtse mo nas te/ zhes dang /nges par 'byung ba dang 'di bzod pa nas/ zhes dang / bar chad med pa dang 'di chos mchog nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub lte/ zag med gsar ba zhes bshad pa'i phyir te/rgyan las/ byang chub la ni nye ba dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gser 'phreng las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la nye ba dang / 'di mthong lam nas te/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gsum pa grub ste/ myur ba'i de mdo las/ bud med 'di ni ring sor mi 'ogs par btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chen de dag ring por mi thogs par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de'i lung bstan sa brgyad pa'i yin pa'i phyig rgyud bla ma las/ sa bdun rjes 'brel dri ma rnams/ /mngal rlu bas dri ma dag dang mtshungs/ /mngal sbrubs dral 'dra mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes rnam par smin pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des na sa brgyad par gzhon nu'i sar bshad pa yang de yin no/ /ji skad du/ gser 'phreng las 'di sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar te/ zhes so/ /②rtags bzhi pa grub ste/ gzhan don gyi spyor ba sogs lnga sa brgyad pa yan chad gzhan don yod du bshad pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ rnam kun don yod shes par sga /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gser 'phreng las/ de ltar gzhan don byed pa 'phel 'grib med par rtogs pa/ nas/ de rnams sa brgyad pa nas te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gartags lnga pa grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ rin ngo che sbyin pa dang 'di sa dang po nas yod kyang dgu pa nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 4rtags drug pa grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/120
sbyor ba/rnam par dag pa dang 'di sa bcu pa nas te/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyig tsartags bdun pa grub ste/gser 'phreng las/ 'di tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar te/ brgyad pa yan chad ni de ltar sa mtshams kyis phye nas byed mi dgos pas sesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/skabs 'di'i lam gyor ba de yin par sgrub pa dang yab sras dgongs pa gcig dbyangs gcig go/yang kha cig na re/ tshegs chen bh+yor ba la stong nyid ma rtogs pas khyab zer na/ sems dpa' dbang rtul tshogs lam chen 4 ba'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi gnas chos can/ der thal/de'i phyir/ dbang po rno rtul gnyis das de nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi gnas nges par thob pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ chos nyid la sgom byung gi gsal snang ma thob pas skrag pa shas cher skye ba'i dbang du byas pa ni/ dus yun ring mo zhig nas yum gyi rtogs pa skye bas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig /'di'i lung bstan 'thob pa'i spyor ba yin na lung bstan 'ob zin pas khyab zeg la la de yin na sangs rgyas las lung bstan dngos su thob pas khyab zer na/ gzhan dag na re/ de gnyis ka mi 'thad par thal/ 'jub pa ma 'ongs pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyig der thal/de sangs rgyas gnyis sam gsum sogs las mi ring bar lung bstan thob pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ nyi snang las/ lung bstan thob pa'i sbyongar ba ni/ nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yid la byed pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gam gnyis las mi 'da' bar lung bstan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir na lanar ma khyab ste/ des lung bstan thob zin kyang rang dus sangs rgyas med kyang sangs rgyas du ma dang 'phrad pas lung ston pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen las/ de bzhin bstogigs pa gcig gam gnyis sam gsum las mi 'da' ste/ nge nas byang chub sems dpa' de phyis lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba de ltar ni ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang de rnams las zhes bya ba ni tha tshig go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyis121
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/rang lugs la/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i spros bral du sgom pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'gyor de skabs 'der bstan gyi sems dpa'i spyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyi shu yod/ dang po lnga tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar dang / drug pa tshogs lam chung ngu nas tshogs lam chen po'i bar dang / bcu bzhi'i sa mtshams rgyan snang ltar gser 'phreng las bshad pa de yin no/ /rtsod spong la khon re/ khyod kyi sa mtshams mi lan par thal/sher 'byung gis sbyor lam la lnga bzhag pa'i phyiran ma khyab ste/ de lnga'i mi gnas pa'i semasadapa'i bh+yor ba lamong thos byung bsam byung sgom byung gsumagu'od pade bzhin du gzhan bzhi lalapas da pa'i pyid rgyas par gser 'phreng ltar ro/ /lenadag thal rang su'i lugs la'angadagag bya'i khyad par ma gtogs bh+yor ba nyi shu'i ming don len bzhin dgos shing phar phyin sgom tshul mthar thugasan pas cung zad pye ba yin no/ /122
sbyor ba'i yon tan/gnyis pa la spyor ba'i yon tan dang / de bsgom pa'i gegs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsabar/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la serdzogs pa/ /87na tan rnam pa bcu bzhi 'o/ /zhes pa rtsa'grel byung / 'phros sbyo ra mtha' dpyad gsum/ dang 4 ni/ shā ri'i bu phyogs bcu 'dzig rten kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med pa dag na sangs rgyas tshad med grangs med pa gcig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba'i sangs rgyas de snyed kyang byang chen sher phyin 'di 'dri ba 'chang ba klog pa kha ston byed tshul bzhin yid la byed bsgom pa la dgongs par mdzad pa ni chos nyid yin no/ /nas/ phar phyin drug po rnams la 'jug pa las brtsone 'grus nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i mdo tshan bzhis sbyongar ba'i yon tan mtha' yas bshad pa rje btsun gyis bcu bzhir byas te 'chad par 'di byung / gnyis pa ni/ rnam rdzogs kyor ba bsgom pa'i yon tan chos can/ bcu bzhi yod de/ bdud kyi mthu bcom pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis dgongs pa dang /des gzigs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang nye ba dang / don che ba dang / yul dpyad pa dang / yon tan rdzogs pa dang / smra ba'i skyes bu nyid dang / mi phyed pa nyid dang / dge mthun mong ma yin pa skye ba dang / dam bca' sgrub pa dang / 'bras bu rgya che ba dang / sems can gyi don bsgrub pa dang /'dod don nges par thob pa'i yon tan dang bcu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/mtha' dbyad pa la gsum las/ dang po la kha cig na re/ khungar ba bsgoms pa la brten nas thob pa'i yon tan de/ theg chen spyor ba'i yon tan sgya mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos dgra bcom rgyud kyi gzhi shes rgyur ba bsgoms pa las thob pa'i mngon rtogs chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyongar ba'i yon tan yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig der thal/ rang thob byed zeg dman gyi bh+yor 123
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/ba'i yon tan yin pa'i phyis rtsabar 'dod na/ rang thob byed kyi sbrengar ba bsgoms pa las thob pa'i yon tan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de'i mig yang kha cig na re/ theg chen gyi sbyi ra ba bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon de/ zeg chen sprungar ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen spyor ba dang bdud kyi mthu bcom pa'i yon tan chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyis rtags grub ste/ sher phyin nyan bsam sgom gsum la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis slob pa chos nyid yin pas bdud kyis mi tshugs pa'i miganyi snang las/ bdud kyi mthu bcom pa'i 'dzin tan ni/ bdud bar chad byed par brtsone pa la zhugs su zin kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gangs rgyas kyis dgongs shing yongs su bzung ba ni bdud kyi mthu bcom pa'i rgyu yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ de dang dus mnyam pa'i mig yang kha cig na re/theg chen gyi sbyongar ba bsgom stobs kyis/ thob pa'i sems dpa'i yon tan de/ zeg chen bh+yor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nying zer na/ rgyan gyi gdul bya'i 'thob bya'i rnam mkhyen rlasnas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub lte/ bcu bzhi'i yon tan lnga pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bh+yor ba bsgom pa'i yon tan don che ba sogs kyi nang gi 'bras bu che ba de yin pa'i phyig nyi snang la sa/ don che ba nyid la sogs pa'i yon tan ni/ zhes dang / de'i mdo las/ sher phyin zab mo 'di bris shing 'chang bar 'gyur ba de dag ni don che ba dang 'bras bu che ba dang zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rnam bshad las/ sangs rgyas (1)ba'i 'bras bu che ba/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig sa mtshams la kha cig na re/ bcu bzhi'i dang 'o bzhi spru ra lam dang lhag ma bcu sa bcu la 'jog par thal/ ku ma ra shris de ltar bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ dang po bzhi gtso cher rung yang bcu'i sa mtshamasanges can ma yin pa'i phyis 'dod —— — ————wawa ———1 dpar zengasaganyis pa / sangasargyasabs/124
sbyor ba'i yon tan/mi nus te/ mos spyod kyi tshogs lam na'ang bcu bzhi dbang rnon la yod pa'i phyig tshig gsal las/ yon tan 'di dag ni las dang 4 ba'i sa nas brtsams te ldan mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ skyon rnams kyor ba mi skye ba'i rgyu yin pas yon tan yang spyor ba skye ba'i rgyur 'dod zer na mi 'thad par thal/ yon tan de'i 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bshad dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de kyor ba sgom pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyig nyi snang las/ spyor ba'i phan yon bshad zin to/ /zhes dang] gser 'phreng las/ slob dpon yang phan yon du bzhed pas de'i 'bras bu yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de la kho na re/ byang sems tshogs lam chung ngu ba'i rgyud kyi lhor bdang dus mnya5 pa'i dang 4 bzhi chos can/ tshogs lam pa'i spyor ba de'i 'bras bu yin par thal/ sbyongar ba bsgom pa'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lam ma zhugs nas sher phyin bsgom pa'i 'bras bu tshogs lam thob ma thag pa nas 'byung ba'i phyis der thal/ slob lam du rnam mkhyen sgom pa'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen zob par khas len pa'i phyir te/ sgom tshul bzhi 〈snags bshad zin pa'i pyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ de 'dra ba'i tshogs lam gyi lhor ba dang dus mnyam pa'i phyis khyab ste/ 'di'i phan yon de tshogs lam pa'i sbyongar ba bsgom pa'i yon tanasan pa'i phyisder thal/ gser 'phreng las/ de'i phyir nus pa dang nus can yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gzhung 'dis bshad tshul la rnam rtog mang yang ma spros/ gser 'phreng las so /rang lugs la/ zeg chen gyi sbyongar ba bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i zeg chen lam zhugs rgyud kyi yon tam de/ theg chen gyi spyor ba bsgom pa'i theg chen gyi yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu bzhi yod/ sa mtshams rigs nges kyi tshogs lam chung ngu'i de'i phan yon bcu bzhi nas/sangs rgyas sa'i bcu bzhi'i bar yod/ rtsod spong la kho na re/ theg chen gyi spyor ba chos can/theg chen bh+yor ba'i yon tan yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod khyod kyi yon tan ma 125
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/yin par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sprungar ba bsgom pa'i 'dzin tan yin pa'i shāshādzi tha pasdupa dī lha shārnyi( dwo snro rnyipa kau shāmi/ gh+nā dzin k+ṣiṃ zlon t+t+waṃ )pa na dzir swā/ k+ṣiṃ tan ma yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen sgya yon tan yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sbyi1ra ba bsgom pa'i yon tan yin kyang sbyongar ba dang nus pa can gyi 'dzin tan du khas mi len pa'i phyir/ byang sems bh+yor lam pa'i dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje chos can/ dmigs med de khyod kyi dmigs par thal/ khyod dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir/ zhagar gsum shes sam/'di'i yon tan drug pa yul dpyad pa'i skabs su bstan pa'i gnas tshad la 'grel pa mang po'i lugs tha dad tshul shes dgos kyang phar phyin pa snga ma dag la dbugs rgyu ba mi snang bas spros na mkhas 'dod du 'gro snyam nas ma bris serdzo/ /126
sbyor ba'i skyon/gnyis pa ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /drug tu nges par rtogs par bya/ /zhes pa la/ 'phyos sbyongar ba mtha' dpyad pa gsum/ dang 4 ni/ mdo las/ rab 'byor slobs pa ha cang 'phyi lte skyon de ni byang chen gyi bdud las su rig par bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ci nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur bar rtag tu rgyun mi chad par bsrung ba dang skyabs pa dang sbra bar mdzad par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i skyon zhe drug bshad pa rje btsun gyis 'chad par 'di byung / gnyis pa ni/ zeg chen gyi bh+yor ba'i skyon chos can/ zhe drug yod de/ bh+yor ba'i 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyi shu/ rang gzhan gang rung la brten nas mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum/ 'gal rkyen gzhan la brten pa gsum rnams yod pa'i phyid mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig na re/ theg chen gyi rgyur ba skye ba dang gnas pa la gegs byed kyi bdud kyi las de/ theg chen spyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i slobs pa ha cang myur ba'i spyor skyon chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'grel pa las/ slobs pa ha cang myur ba dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshogs lam pa de'i rgyud la sbyongar ba med par thal/ sbyongar ba skye ba dang gnas pa'i gegs rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus/ yang snga ma dang dbang rtul gyis tshegs chen pos thob pa gnyis re re nas chos can/ bdud las yin par thal/ bh+yor ba skye gnas la gegs byed pa'i bdud las yin pa'i phyig rtags mtshan nyid la khas/ 'di'i skyon zhe drug kun bdud las ma yin pa'i phyig der thal/ bdud dngos kyis byas pa'i las de bdud las dngos dang / de las gzhan 'ga' zhig 'dra ba dang / 'ga' zhig de'i bdud las kyi rgyu byed pas bdud las su bshad 127
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/pa'i phyir/ gnod 'joms chung ba las/ de la bdud kyi las zhes bya ba yang ni bdud nyid kyis bar chad byas pa'o/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag kyang bdud kyi las dang 'dra ba'i phyir bdud kyi las zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig /rang lugs ni/ bsal bya skyon dang / sel byed gnyen po gnyis/ zeg chen gyi bh+yor ba skye gnas gong 'phel ci rigs la gegs byed pa'i cha nas bdud las su bshad pa de/ khu1ra ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na zhe drug yod/ sa mtshams zhe drug po phal cher las dang po ba'i sa dang / spyor lam la yod cing / phra mo sa bdun pa man chad na yod/ zeg chen 'dor ba sogs bdun ni tshogs lam man chad kho nar yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ phyogs bcu'i 'dzig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag gis kyang sher phyin zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par dbo ngas se / /zhes sem/ /zab mo'i sbyongar ba kho tshos can/ skyon mang yang sbrengar ba ba〈snam pa'i bar chad mi thub ste/ sangs rgyas de nyid kyis /shā dzopa ༷dho pazhi /na bsru pad pa /zhirdopa spra /pa snadri/ zhiñja /rmo paX sbya gh+nā hā k+ta gshā papa gnas dang sems can don yongs mi gtong dang / /ji skad sprus bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ /zhes zug/ /128
sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/gsum pa sbrengar ba'i mtshan nyid la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsabadgang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung / 'phros sbyongar mtha' dpyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ yum las/ sher phyin 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bskyed pa/ zhes zugags kyis sbrengar ba'i shes mtshan byi( ༵ tram̐/ dīr+sha dī ṭ+wāṃ lha/dri hāpa ༈ r+sha dzo rnyi (spya ñcha dī sna/tā ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ /sna rmo/ ༵ dī (spya hādī / bzhi yod de/ gang gis mtshon par byed pa shes pa'i bdag nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang] nyan rang dang /rnyi parnyi ṭ+wāṃ lha/ pa/ drid bhe+e r+sha r+nghi rdzu zlos ṭ+wāṃ 〉( khripa k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷sna /ji padī pyi pa ༵ lha(shā /sra bzhi 〈snad pa'i pyid 'grel pa las/ mtshan nyid ni rnam pa bzhir shes par bya'o/ /zhes zug/ /mtshan rnyi(ṭ+wāṃ smi pa ༵ sna 〉spyanarnyi dī/ tāshā/lha lda (spya ༈ rnyi/ kā spyan ny+pha ci dzo r+sha shā/ bya pa( nashe/ dh+ri 'thad par thal/ shes mtshan rtags su byas nas gyar ba'i ngo bo nyid yin sgrub dang / yod sgrub gang byas kyang khyab pa ma nges pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na shes mtshan med par thal/ shes mtshan la sbrengar ba'i ngo bo nyid kyis khyab pa'i phyig ma grub na/ rjes ldog gnyis grub pa( hār+sha/ shā /( dṛ )pas gas paX tā /lha ༵ pā/ (mi sna shālhas ṅgi |༷ sa/ /sbyo rnyi r+sha ba(shā pa la kho na re/ de rung bar thal/ shes mtshan la mi srid rnam gcod dang / khyad mtshan la gzhan 129
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/wawaldan rnam gcod dang / byed mtshan la mi ldan rnam gcod byas chog pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab ste/ de tsam gyis tshul gsum gyi don mi 'grub pa'i phyig dpag gzhi mkhyen gsum la mi rung pa'i phyir/ gser 'phreng las/ 〈snab lam na rnam mkhyen med pas mkhyen gsum :snas can du ma sprib rdo/snga/spra ༵ rmi/na/ pa(dzo ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༵ r+sha spyan parnyi dhi hūm̐ pazlo( ga/ ༵༵/ ༵ (3 ṭā shā hūm̐ bli dz+nyo ṭ+wāṃ pas bh+yor ba mtshon pa shes mtshan/ de la rnam dag skye ba khyad mtshan sogs su 'dod zer na/ de shin tu mi 'thad par thal/ sngar rnam pa'i skabs kyi mkhyen gsum dang / ming 'dra yang don gtan nas mi 'dra ba'i phyig der thal/ sngar bden bzhi'i mi rtag 〈snags mkhyen pa'i cha nas bshad la/'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs kyi yul mi 'dra ba zhe brgyad la de ltar bshad pa'i phyir dang] khyad mtshan yang nor ba'i phyir/ gser 'tsheng las/ yul zhe brgyad la gsungs pas de gnyis mkhyen gsum gyi ming mtshungs kyang mkhyen lugs mi 'dra bas/ zhes gsungs pas phyir/ yang sngon gyi chen po kha cig na re/ mtshon bya chos sku'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'i khungar ba la/༷༷ two // ñjaṃ /rdo ༷ dī smi ༷ 9 9 ṭ+wāṃ /khri/ / rnyi dwo skyi peṃ lta tram̐ ṣā| sbyo/ hūm̐ ñjaṃ ༷ mtshon par zer ba ston par 'dod de/ rnam bshad las/ mtshon bya ni khyad mtshan dang byed mtshan gyis rnam rdzogs khungar bar mtshon pa ma yin gyi/ zhes dang / des yul gyis yul can 'phangs nas bstan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ rtsabar/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / /zhes sogs 〈sna lo ka bzhis shes pa'i mtshan nyid bcu drug pa gsum gyi dang 4 gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan lam sher phyin bcu drug bshad pa ma yin par thal/ shes khyad byed gsum 130
sbyor ba'i mtshan nyidgyi mtshan nyid don brgyad kyi yul gyis yul can spyor ba'i mtshan nyid shugs la 'phangs pa'i phyig 'dod na/ shin tu mi 'thad par thal/ rje btsun gyis de bshad pa gang zhig /'phags seng gnyis kyis kyang bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ rtsabar/ thams cad shes pa nyid skabs hūm̐/ ma/ (snan pa ༵ lha / tā snyad ṣ+ṭṛ ༈ hūm̐/ ma/ sprapa (lha ༵ rnyi( /rmo r+sha pa/ /sna la/ ṭā g+ne (( ༵ gnyis pa grub lte/ nyi snang las/ de la shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni re zhig thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dbang du byas nas rnam pa bcu drug tu shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid 'grel pa las kyang] shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis tshul bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi khungar ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin mtshon pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gakhor gsum/gzhan yang] rtsabad stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang / /sogs kyis lam shes kyi shes mtshan dngos su ma bshad par thal/ shes khyad byed gsum gyi mtshan nyid dngos su mi ston pa kho nar bshad pa'i phyid 'dod na/ rtsabs lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyi ni/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ des dngos su tshig zin la bshad pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa las/ shes pa'i rnam pa'i khyad par bcu drug gis ji lta ba bzhin du lam shes pa nyid kyi sbyi ra ba dag mtshon pas na/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khungar ba mtshon zhes pa'i don yod pa'i sgyig nyi snang las/ de ni lam shes pa nyid kyi shes pa'i rnam pa bcu drug gis/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / rtsabar/ de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas/ /sogs kyis rnam mkhyen lhor ba'i shes mtshan dngos su ma bstan par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ rtsabag rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni/ /shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid khyab lte/ 'grel pa las/ de ltar bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dgus shes pa'i mtshan nyid sbyi'i 131
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/ngo bo nyid du brjod nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang / bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis/ /nas/ khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin/ /zhes dngos su gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/spyor ba'i khyad mtshan dngos su ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gshor gsum/ khyab cing 'dod mi nus lte/'grel pa las/ bzod pa dang shes pa'i mtshan nyid skad cig ma bcu drug gis lam shes pa nyid la sogs pa'i sbrengar ba dag mtshon pas na khyad par gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lhagar gsum/ khyab ste/ spyor ba dag ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyi snang las/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid brjod par bya bayin pas/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ khyad par gyi don yang ga rang las khyad par 'phags pa'i ngon yin pa'i phyig nyi snang las/ khyad zhugs zhes bya ba ni nyan thos la sogs pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gzhan yang / nyi snang las/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid brjod par bya ba yin pas/phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ phan dang sogs kyis bh+yor ba'i byetshod mtshan dngos su ma bshad pa'i phyig ma grub na dngos/ khyab lte/ rtsabs tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste/ /'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / rtsabar/mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na/ /mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ ngo bo nyid kyi spyor ba'i mtshan nyid dngos su ma bshad pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi'i bshad pa bsdoman mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsagacig bstan pa'i phyis 'grel pa las/ de ltar spyir gcig tu bsdoms na ni dgu bcu rtsagacig tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid byas pa la kho na re/ byed mtshan dang mtshan gzhi rnams chos can/ rang 'bras sangs 'phags kyi gzhan don skyed byed du mtshon par thal/ sangs 'phags kyi gzhan don phun tshogs skyed byed yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de de skye9da byed yin kyang mtshon tshul de ltar mi mtshon pa'i pyid der thal/ de 132
sbyor ba'i mtshan nyidthog mar lam sher pyin dang mkhyen gsum gyi lhor ba tshad mas nges rjes su de rnam mkhyen gyi rgyur nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum gyi rnam dbye nges nas 'bras bu sher phyin la yid dpyod kyis don gnyer tsam ma yin par tshad mas lam 'bras kyi sher phyin 'grel bsngas pa la gron du lam sher phyin tshad masanges pa sngon du 'phrodagos pas lam sher phyin mtshan nyid bzhi'i sgo nas bshad pa'i phyis rnam bshad las/ gzhan don phun tshogs skyed byed yin yang tshul de ltar mtshon pa min te/ nas/ sbyi dang bye brag gi mtshan nyid lade dag ces so/ /sangs rgyas sa na 'di'i shes mtshan yod par thal/ sangs rgyas sa na mkhyen gsum yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ mkhyen gsum gyi shes mtshan tsam min gyi/ de'i sbyongar ba'i shes mtshan yin pa'i phyig der thal/ mtshan nyid bzhi bshad pa'i dgos pade'i sgyid rnam bshad las/ shes mtshan sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhed pa sogs ni/ mtshan nyid 'di dag gi skabs don ma rtogs pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigyang kha cigan re/ khyad mtshan gyis shes mtshan zhe drug rang rang gi ldog panas kyang ga rang gi gyor ba las khyad zhugs par bstan par thal/des lam rnam gnyis kyi so gnyis rang ldoganas kyang khyad zhugs par bstan pa'i phyiran ma khyab nye/gzhi shes kyide rang ldog gis khyad ma zhugs la rdzas kyis khyad zhugs pasan gzhi shes kyi de ma bstan la lam rnam gnyis kyide rang ldoganas kyang khyad zhugs pasadangos su bstan pa'i pyid rnam bshad las/ gzhi shes kyor ba tsamani rang gi ldog pas nyan rang gi bh+yor ba las khyad par byed mi nus shing] zhes so/ /yang kha cig na re/ gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan bcu drug po gzhi shes bh+yor ba ma yin par thal/ 'jig rten 'jig med ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi 7)ga rten bden med rtogs pa'i lam sher phyin yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ de gzhi shes sbyongar ba zin byed yin la gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan ma yin pa'i phyid gabar 133
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/'dod mi rigs par thal/ gzhi shes sbyordzor ba'i shes mtshan bcu drug yod pa'i phyiggnyis pa rang lugs la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshon sga mtshan nyid/ ji ltar mtshon/ sa mtshams lnga las/ dang 4 ni/ sems dpa'i rgyud kyi ngo bo nyid bcu drug dang kyor ba nyi shu lta bhu/ gnyis pa ni/ stong nyid dam bdag med phra rags gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs thabs shes rdzogs pas zin pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brol gyi ldog chanas bzhag pa'i semasadapa'i rnal 'gyor de lam sher pyin gyi mtshan nyid/ mdo las sher phyin zhes pa lam gyi de dang don stong nyid gtso bas cha bzhag byas so/ /'der spyor bcas bshad do/ /dbye na mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas brgya dang bdun cu dang/ mtshan nyid bzhi'i ldog cha nas mtshan nyid go gcig ldog pa'i dbye ba yod/ gsum pa ni/sbyor mtshan nyid la rnam grangs du ma yod de/ me'i tsha ba lta bu rang gi mtshan nyid/ bdag med lta bu sgyi'i mtshan nyid/ dngos 4 gcig la byas mi rtag dngos 4 so so'i mtshan nyid gsum lta bu ldog cha nas phye ba'i mtshan nyid dang / don de la ma khyab khyab ches gnyis gcod pa'i mtshan nyid rigs mi mthun sel ba'i mtshan nyid dang log rtog sel ba'i mtshan nyid lta bu du ma yod pa'i 9ga des na lader ni rigs mi mthun sel ba'i mtshan nyid dang / ldog ga'i mtshan nyid gtso ste/lam sher pyin la ldog pa'i sgo nas shes khyad byed ngo'i mtshan nyid bzhi byas pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum gyi dmigs pa gang rung la dmigs nas/ tshungar ba de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba shes pa sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i lanar bstan sher phyin de 'dor bltan shes mtshan rgyur ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'grel pa las/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi/ zhes serdzo/ /dbye na sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyongar ba/ lam shes sbyongar ba/ rnam mkhyen sbyongar ba gsum/ gzhi shes kyi dmigs pa ltar dmigasanas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba shes pa sogs bcu drug gi cha nas bzhag pa'i 'der bstan lam sher phyin de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug sogs yod/ rtsa134
sbyor ba'i mtshan nyidbag de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs byung / lam shes kyi dmigs pa ltar dmigs nas stong nyid mtshan med shes pa sogs bcu drug gi cha nas bzhag pa'i 'dir bstan lam sher phyin de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug sogs yod/ rtsabag stong nyid mtshan med sogs byung / rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs rnam ltar byas nas sangs rgyas nyid kyi chos shes pa sogs bcu drug gi cha nas bzhag pa'i lam sher pyin de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug sogs yod/ rtsabar/ brjod dang shes mdzad sogs byung / bsam mi khyab sogs chos bcu drug ci rigasakyis theg dman las khyad par du 'phags pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i 'dir bstan lam sher pyin de/ 'dir bstan sems dpa'i khyad mtshan kyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug sogs yerdzod/ rtsabad bsam mi khyab dang dredags byung / gzhan la phan bde skyongab glegags byed chos bcu gcig gi cha nas bzhag pa'i lam sher phyin de/ 'dir bstan sems dpa'i byed mtshan khungar ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu gcig sogs yod de/ rtsabs phan dang bde dang sogs so/ /shes khyad snyed snaX dī /sna stasno /sna'i lazlo/ ṭ+wāṃ ༷r+sha ñcā pa/ ṇ+ṭhī /shā r+sha sbyo zlomi (lha spra ༵/ (pa shes kyi lnga dang / rnam mkhyen gyi bdun dang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ rtsabag nyon mongs rtags dang sogs byung/ mtshon tshul ni so so la mtshon bh+yor re bya ste rtogs sla/ lnga pa sa mtshams yod de/ mtshan nyid bzhi ka tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar 〈snad/rtsod spong la kho na re/ sems dpa'i rgyud kyi ngo bo nyid bcu drug chos can/ r+ṇa rang lhor ba las shes khyad byed gsum gyis 'phags par thal/ khyod de gsum gyis mtshon nas bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyis ladod na/ lana'i rtogs rigs gang rung ga rang la med par thal/ ladod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/135
smras pa/zub dbang gsam pa'i 'od zer phyogs kun tu/ /song bas nyer bkug rgyal sras mi mjed khams/ /khyab dbus 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /rigs can gsum la bdud tsi'aphyed pa'ang lade/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis las gces pas /lan gnyis lam gsum gtad pas sa gsum gyi/ /rims kun zhi mdzad zab mo'i a mṛ ta'i/ /glegs bam gzugs 'khyil 'di ni skal ba bzang / /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//136
thar pa cha mthun/gnyis pa thar pa cha mthun nas bzung lte skye rim la/ grangs med gsum gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi thog ma ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ngos bzung ba dang /rgyud smin byed lam skye rim dang / mngon rtogs khyad par can skye rim bshad pa gsum las/dang po ni/ rtsabar/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ /nas/ shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga/ /zhes byung / 'phros kyor mtha' dpyad pa gsum/ dang rdzo ni/ mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chen thog mar sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ma bral bar/ zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i mdo du mas thar pa cha mthun chen po dang] chung 'bring bstan pas/ dang po 3ga chen gyi thar cha yin pas dngos su dang gzhan gnyis shugs bstan byas nas 'chad par drangs ma thag byung / gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ sngar bshad pa'i spyor ba brgya don gsum sgom tshul dang] lam sher phyin mtshan nyid bzhis bshad pa ltar bsgom pa'i lam gyi 'og mar theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun skye ba dang / bskal chen grangs med gsum gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi thog mar dus mnyam du skye ste/ zeg chen rigs can gyis dad sogs lnga la mkhas pa'i de ltar bsgom pas myong ba thon pa dang / tshogs lam du zhugs shing yul lnga la mkhas pas lam las mi ldog pa'i phyir/ dang pho grub lte/ 'grel pa las/ 'di la thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa yin par 'dod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam bshad las/ ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi mngon par rtogs pa'i rigs mtha' dag la/ nas/ thar pa cha mashun rgyud la skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid mdo las kyang / sher phyin dang thabs mkhas dang ma bral bar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 137
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/dang de rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po la sogs pa de yid la sems kyang mtshan mar mi byed/rnam thar sgo gsum la mtshan mar mi byed na/ de gnyis su mi ltang zhing ma smas ma nyams par bla med rdzogs byang du 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid mtha' dbyad pa la gsum/ dang yo la kha cig na re/ rnam mkhyen rang rgyud la sgrub par mkhas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi chos mngon rtogs de/ 'der bstan thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg dman du ltang bar nges pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ der thal/ 'dir bstan zeg chen gyi de yin pa'i phyig der thal/ zeg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun yin pa'i phyig khyab ste/ rtsabag thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod/ /ces pas theg pa gsum ga'i tshogs lam bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/theg chen gyi de dngos bltan gtso phal dngaka nyan rang gi de shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/des brgya don gsum gyi thar pa cha mthun bstan pa'i phyig mdo las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ma bral bar sbyin pa/ nas/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar du bsgom zhing mtshan mar mi byed/ ces gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ le brgyad ma las/ zhes bya ba ni thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa spyir bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ rang rgyud la de bskyed pa'i thabs mkhas dang bral ba'i de yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ cha/do las/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ nas/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin yid la byed kyang mtshan mar mi byed de/ byang chen 'di ni ma snad cing ma smas par bla med rdzogs byang du 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ khyab ste/nyarna rang du nyung ba de snad smas kyi don yin pa'i phyig nyi snang las/ snad pa'i/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i sar ltang ba'o/ /smas pa ni byang chub chen po las nyams pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid yang kha cig na re/ zeg chen tshogs lam pa dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum po de rim pa ltar ngos bzung yod par thal/ zeg chen gyi rigs can byang sems tshogs lam pa dbang non dngaka rang rgyal gyi 138
thar pa cha mthun/rigs can byang sems tshogs lam pa dbang 'bring dang / nyan thos kyi rigs can byang sems tshogs lam pa dbang rtul yin pa'i pyid der thal/ 'di'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ ci yang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos skya zeg pa ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' rang rgyal gyi theg pa ba'am/byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i zeg pa ba gsum du 'dod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ de byang sems btags pa ba dang / dad sogs chung 'bring gnyis nyan rang gi zeg pa chung 'bring yin pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ dad sogs chen po 3ga pa chen po yin la/dad sogs chung ngu dang 'bring theg pa chung 'bring yin gyi mdo'i sgras zin la ga thos la byang chub sems dpar ming btags pa tsam la brten nas/ theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam la gnas pa'i rigs can gsum gyidabye ba byed pa sogs ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbyas pa la kho na re/ khyab pa yod par thal/nyi snang las/ de ltan 'on/ nyan thos kyi zeg pa ba la sogs pa'i byang chub semasadapa' rnam pa gsum med pa nyid kyis mi 'dod pa byang chub sems dpa' gcig tu thal bas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyir na yang ma khyab ste/ don dam par byang sems gcig pu yang mi 'dod la/ byang sems kyi gnas skabs kyi nyan rang gi byang sems du ma yang mi medod pa'i phyir te/nyi snang las/ bden padang gnas pa'i byang chub semasadapa' gcigadang du mar khas mi len pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid rtsabar dz+nyo rtulaganyis bshad pa'i rtul po 3gdamanayin zeran/'o na/de no rtul dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas par mtshungs kyangadad brtson sogs lnga la skye myur ba rnon po dang skye bul ba rtul po'i dbang gis rdzogs byang thob dka' sla gnyis yod pa ma yin par thal/ rtul po 3ga dman la byed pa'i mig 'dod mi nusate/ 'grel pa las/ yul rnam pa lnga la ches mkhas pasanano/ /de lta mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyiradang/gser 'phreng las/ 'dor rtul po 3gdaman gyisan par rgya bod 'ga' zhig bzhed kyang mi 'thad de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang 139
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/kha cigan ba rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byadabang po rno rtulaganyis su mnges par thal/de gnyis gang rung mayin pa'idabang 'bring zur du brtsidagos pa'i migader thal/nyi snang rnam 'grel grags cha slobadapon gyi le brgyad mar tshogs lam che 'bring chung gsum byas pa'i phyiran ma khyab/ rtags grub lte/ gser 'tsheng las/nyi snang rnam 'grel grags cha slobadapon rjes 'brangasadang bcas pas chung 'bring che gsum du bshad la/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig 'dod mi nus te/ zeg chenadabang non ma yin pa'i theg chen pa dbang rtul du 'gyur ba'i pyid khyab lte/ des 'bring po zur du mimi dgos par rtul podabang po che chung gnyis byed pa'i spyad gser 'phreng las/ slobadapon gyidagongs pas hā/ lhan (( dī dzo ༵ ṭ+wā byi(dī gā gh+nā k+ṣiṃ ṭā ༵ /rdornyi sna pahā ṭ+wāṃ parna/ spra pasna r+ṇi dī tram̐ ༷)/ rjes 'brangasadang chos kyi rjes 'brangs gnyis sunges par ston pasan gyi/dbang po 'greng po zur du 'chad pa dang/ rtul po 3ga dman pa la bh+yor ba sogasani gzhung gidon phyin ci log ces gsungs pa'i phyig zhib cha 'de tshogs bh+yor mthong sgom lam gong 'og thams cad du shes dgos/rang lugs la/ lus sems kyi rten gnyis sems bskyed dang 'dra/ dad sogs lnga la mkhas pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i rang bzhin gyi dbang non gyi chos mngon rtogs de/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi zeg chen thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes nyi tshe ba'i rang bzhin gyi dbang 'bring gi chos mngon rtogs de/ rang rgyal gyi de'i mtshan nyid/ thabs shes nyi tshe ba'i rang bzhin gyi dbang rtul gyi chos mngon rtogs de/ nyan thos kyi de'i mtshan nyid yin te/ 'di gnyis shugs bstan yin pa'i phyig rtsabag nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbye ba thos bsam gtso che yang sgom byung yod de/nyi snang las/ 'di dag thams cad thos pa dang bsam pa'i rang bzhin yin par shes par bya ste/140
thar pa cha mthun/de thog ma kho nar bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /sgra bshad yod de/ thar pa ni bral ba yin la de'i cha la phan pas na thar pa cha mthun zhes brjod par 'phags pas bshad pa'i phyig rgyan la brten nas yul lnga gang rung de dang de rtogs dgos kyi theg chen rigs can de/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na de'i ched du bya ba dbang pe swārdo rtul gnyis yosnad/ sa mtshams lam ma zhugs nas 'phags lam bar du 〈snad la/ de yan chad na'ang gdams ngag dang rjes bstan gang rung re byas na yod kyang gnyis lnga'i dbang du byas na med par shes dgos te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rtog ge rten cing ma nges la/ /ma khyab kun rdzob skyo ba can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig lung la brten pa sogs lnga so skye kho nar bshad pa'i phyir/zhib cha du ma shes dgos/ yul lnga'i de yod de/ bden par med kyang dus gsum gyi zeg chen gyi lam 'bras la shes nas yid ches kyi dad pa rnyed pa de skabs 'di'i dad pa la mkhas tshul dang des gzhan la'ang 'dra/rtsod spong la kho na re/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya gnyis rdzogs byang lenab dka' sla'i khyad par med par thal/ gnyis las de thob dka' ba'i phyis der thal/ dus kyi sgo nas thob dka' ba'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ dus ring yang gdul bya'i dbang yin gyi myur du bzod pa'i gdul bya yang yod pa'i mig sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bu'i lam bgrod pa myur ba gnyis yod pa'i pyid yang kha cis/ na re/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya la byang 'phags kyang yod zer na/'o na rgyan gyi don thams cad tshad mas nges zin pa'i byang 'phags chos can/ khyod rgyan la ched du brten dgos yin par thal/ khyod de'i ched du bya ba'i de yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ don shes pa yi chos rnams kun/ /gzings dang 'dra ba nyid du bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gzings dang 'dra tshul de med par thal/ de'idon thams cad tshad masanges zin kyang ched du brten 141
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/dgos pa'i pyid gzhan yang / dang po de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin na/ sangs ma rgyas bar sgre k+ṣiṃ dzī sdishā ༵༷ gh+nā snyepa r+nghi ༷/ shāX r+sha dī rnyi( (/sa/ hāt+na sbra ༈ lha ༵༵]nga (r+sha ༵ sdir+sha spra par thal ba sogs mang 4 mthong yang sgo bstan pas shes sla/142
nges 'byed cha mthun/gnyis pa la dngos dang / mngon rtogs drug gi go rim la log rtog spangs pa gnyis/dang po ni/ rtsabar/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum byung/ 'phros rgyur mtha' dbyad pa gsum/ 'phros tshul mdo las/ byang chen 'tshang rgya 'dod pas sems can thams cad kyi drung du sems mnyam pa nyid du gnas par ma sogs mdo tshan bcu gnyis kyis sbyor lam bzhi re re la chung 'bring che gsum dang / de dag gi dmigs rnam bshad pa de 'der bshad do/ /lhor ba sla/ mtha' dpyad pa la 'od kha cig na re/ slob dpon bdag nyid chen pos gang la gyar ba'i yul lam rnam pa dang bden pa dmigs par bshad pa nor bar thal/rtsabar/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /sems can thams cad/ ces dang / bden shes pa/ zhes pa'i rnam pa bstan pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ slob dpon gyis sems can thams cad la dmigs par bzhed pa'i sgyid der thal/ sems can thams cad la sems bcus drod sesnags bzhis dmigs par bzhed pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ thams cad kyis thams cad la dmigs par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ rang gi dri ngan bdag nyid chen por byug pa yin pa'i pyid der thal/ gser 'phreng las/ 'dir kha cig /nas/ rtsaba'i bden shes dang dmigs pa sems can thams cad do/ /zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/4zhes gsungs pa'i pyid tshig gsal na re/ sems bcu'i dang po sems mnyam pa nyid kho na drod chung ngu'i sa yin zer na/ des mnyam pa dang byams pa'i sems kyis dmigs shing rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i rnam pa can mi bsgom par thal lo/ /kho na de'i pyid 'dod na/ rgyan snang las/ drod du gtogs pa chung ngu ni mnyam pa dang byams pa'i sems dag gis tshe 'di nyid la gzhan la zo 'tshams pa med 143
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/pa las so/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ le brgyad ma las/ sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems dang byams pa'i sems dang snying rje chen po bskyed par sga zhes sogs kyi mdo sbyar 'dug pa'i phyid gser 'phreng las/ tshig gsal las sems dang po nyid drod chung ngu dang / zhes pa nas/ dang po ni/ 'grel chen gsum ga dang mi mthun la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig byas pa la kho na re/ nged kyi de rung bar thal/ nyi snang las/dro bar gtogs pa chung ngu ni sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid bskyed pa dang / de la dmigs par gnas pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sogs sgras byams pa'i sems dang snying rje'i sems kyang 'don pa'i phyig der thal/ nyi snang sogs las chung 'bring che gsum gyi dmigs pa so sor bshad pa dmigs pa'i phyogs re yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ chung 'bring 〈sna sor bcad pa mtshon pa tsam yin gyi/ thams cad kyis thams cad la dmigs par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ slob dpon drod sogs bzhi la chung 'bring che gsum mi bzhed par thal/ 'grel par tshig gsal kha med pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rtsaba'i tshig dang go bstun tsam yin pa'i phyir/gser 'phreng las/ 'dir chung 'bring gsum dang lhor ba lhur ma blangs par rtsaba'i tshig gis zin tshod bkral nas bzhi 4 sbyo tsam la sbyar ba dang] zhes gsungs pa'i pyig des rnam bshad kyis rtsa'agrel bshad tshul yang der bstun pa'o/ /rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ nyi snang dang rgyan snang gnyis dar bh+yor lam bzhi ga'i chung 'bring che gsum gyi dmigs rnam so sor bshad pa'i phyir dang / mdor bstan dulang nyi snang dang 'grel chen gnyis las/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'di dag kyang chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye bas re re zhing rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid de la kho na re/ bzod chen dang chos mchog skad cig ma yin par 144
nges 'byed cha mthun/thal/ mdzod las/ ji ltar bzod chen skad cig ma/ /gcig yin de bzhin chos kyi mchog /ces gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rang don byed pa'i nyan rang la de ltar bshad la 'di la gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i lhor ba yod pas bzod chos gnyis ka la gsum gsum yod pa'i mir te/ nyi snang las/ 'di ni gzhan la brten pa'i chung ngu dang / sogs dang] 'grel chen las/ de ni rang don gyi dbang du byas pa'i yin/ zhes so/ /yang kha cig/drod sogs bcu gnyis kyi dmigs pa so so kho nar bshad rigs par thal/ rtsabar yang / drod la bcur bshad cing / rtse mor mi dge bcu rang bzhin gyis spong ba dang phar phyin bcu la 'jug pa dang / bzod par bden bzhi la 'jug pa dang 'bras bu bzhi dang rab dga' sogs la 'god pa dang / chos mchog gis sems can smin pa dang sgrib med dang / rab dga' sogs la gnas pa ra byed pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/chos mtshog skabs su sems bcus sems can gyi don byed pa dang / byed tshul yang mi dge bcu spong dang phar phyin la slob pa sosas yin la/ de bzhin du gzhan la'ang 'dra ba'i phyir/ der thal/ lhor lam re re'i skabs na sems bcus dmigs pa dang bden bzhi'i blang dor dang phyin drug la rang gzhan 'god pa sogs byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bzhi ga bsdoms pas rtsa'agrel mdo gsum gyis dmigs rnam tshang bar bstan pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ gsum ga'i skabs su sgom par bya ba'i dmigs rnam gyi don tshang bar bstan pa yin no/ /zhes dang /chung 'bring so sor bcad pa mtshon pa tsam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyisrang lugs la/ gtso sor thabs kyi cha nas khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i don mngon rtogs de/theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ 'dor nyan rang gi drod sogs shugs la bstan no/ /dbye na bcu gnyis yod de/ drod sogs bzhi re re la gsum gsum yod pas so/ /'dir gtso bor rjes thob dang thabs gtso ste/ 'dir rjes thob tu snying rje sogs kyis 145
phar phyin skabs bzhi pa/sems can gyi don byed tshul dang lam la 'god tshul bshad pa'i phyir/ phar phyin lam sgrigs las/ skabs dang por stong nyid rtogs pa'i bh+yor lam gyi rnam gzhag gtso bor bstan cing /'dir rjes kyi gnas skabs gtso sor bstan pa ni/ gong 'og kun bsdoms pas rgyar lam yongs su rdzogs par shes par bya ba'i phyir yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig146
zlos spong /gnyis pa ni/ 'grel pa las/ rnam pa dang lam dang gzhi thams cad/ ces pa nas/ shes par bya'o/ /zhes byung] mtha' dbyad pa la dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la kha cig na re/ 'di zlos spong kho na yin la/ de yang skabs dang yo drug tu bh+yor mthong sgom pa'i lam gsum lan drug bstan kyang skyon med de/ dang po gsum du bshad pa'i sbyor mthong sgom gsum lam mtshan nyid pa dang / skabs bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa gsum gyi skyedar mthong sgom gsum 4 btags pa pa yin pa'i pyir te/ skabs bzhi par sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chung 'bring che gsum la sbyongar mthong sgom gsum du bshad/ lnga par dgu pa'i ye shes chung 'bring che gsum la lhor mthong sgom gsum gyi 〉lhor gsum du bshad/ drug par sa bcu pa'i stod kyi ye shes chung 'bring che gsum la rgyur mthong sgom pa'i lam gsum du bshad pa'i phyig zhes pa'i rtsod tshul ni/ 'grel chen las/ mngon par rtogs pa re re la nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa ci'i phyir brjod ce na/ zhes byung / de'i lan byas tshul/ rnam bshad las/ kha cig /gzhung 'di zlos pa 'ba' zhig tu byas nas/ zhes serdzo/ /'dod tshul de cung zad kyang mi 'thad par thal/ bzhi par bshad tshul mi 'thad/ lnga par bshad tshul yang mi 'thad/ drug pa'i de yang mi 'thad pa'i phyis dang po grub ste/ khyod ltar na tshogs lam las sa brgyad pa'i ye shes dngos su skye bar thal ba dang / bzhi pas sbyongar lam pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags ma bshad par thal ba sogs 'jug pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'grel pa las thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i spro ba can la nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'byung bas/ zhes gsungs pa gang zhig /khyod kyis de'i sbyor lam sa brgyad par byas pa'i nyid gzhan yang / 'grel chen las/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs mtshan nyid dang bcas pa bshad zin rto/ /da ni mi slob 147
