longs sku bshad pa/sogs khong nas ngon pa brngon par sprul pa dang / mi dbang pad+ma skyes 'dul ba'i phyir rgan po'i gzugs su sprul pa glenags grangs med cig car sprul pa'i phyir/ mdo sne rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pa las/ sprul pa'i sku ni rtag tu 'dul ba'i don du pi wang len pa la rtsogs pa bzo dang zhes dang / legs ldan gyis/ phyin ci log tu mngon par zhen pa'i ngon pa 'dul ba'i don du jon pa'i gzugs su sprul pa dang/ mi dbang pad+ma skye 'dul ba'i don du rgan po'i gzugs su sprul pa dang zhes gsungs pa'i phyisyang sna (shā ༵ (na/ hūm̐ rnyi( sprispri rnyi( /ro lhapa rī ā snronā :sna nāṃ ༷ sprang zloji sprapa )pa pa( mtshan dpe'i sku mi 'gyur bar bzhugs pa'i sprul sku yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi sprul sku ye da pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'khor gsum/ gzhan yang / sprul pa'i sku yang yang mi snang bar mi byed par thal/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi sprul sku yod pa'i phyir/ gangor gsum/ yang blun po kha cig/dang po rigs 〈sna 36ra nges kyang sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mi slob pa'i skyes b+thā gcig kho nar 'gyur bar thal/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sangs rgyas nyid du bzhugs nadedag kun/ /rten yang gcig cing zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab ste/ de sangs rgyas thams cad lha dzoX ༵༵ m+bhi hādī spri/ r+sha kli da ༈ r+sha ༷༵/spya sdi pa/ shāshā hāX spra/ pa/ga s+dza r+nghi papa/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg can rigs can la yang rigs phyugs kyi shing rta lta bus 'gro ba 〈snags lnga rdzordzod pa'i phyir/ nges pa dang ma nges pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i 'di lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phyugs kyi shing rta lta bu'i 'gro ba dang / glang 4 che'i shing rta lta bu'i 'gro ba dang / zla ba dang nyi ma lta bu'i 'gro ba dang / nyarna thos kyi rdzu 'phrul lta bu'i 445
skabs brgyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/'gro ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ② 'phrul lta bus 'gro ba'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang sangs rgyas pa'i skabs na sangs rgyas gcig kho na'am mang po yin dris pa'i lan gsum yod de/ kha cig na re/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na sangs rgyas yod dus 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na sangs rgyas mi 'byung zer/ gzhan dag na re/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sangs rgyas gcig gis mdzad pa mdzad kyi/ mang pos sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa mi mdzad zedla la na re/ sangs rgyas kyang mang la/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i chos sku yang mang bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i 'grel pa las/ de la re zhig kha cig na re/ ji srid du 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na yod pa de srid du 'dzig rten gyi khams gzhan du sangs rgyas mi 'byung zer ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ 'grel bshad de nyid las/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sangs rgyas gcig kho na zhig nas/ mang po mngon par rdzogs pas rgyas pa ni med do zhes zer ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gsum pa grub ste/ 'grel bshad de nyid las/ sangs rgyas ni mang 4 zhig yin la/ chos kyi sku la nas/ spangs pa de dag kyang mang po nyid du yin no zhes zer ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyid sangs rgyas pa'i gnas skabs su sangs rgyas gcig las med pa'i mi 'thad par thal/ rigs tha dad pa'i byang sems du ma yod pas sangs rgyas gcig mi 'thad/ tshogs gnyis don med du 'gyur bas de mi 'thad/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa rdzogs pa yod pas kyang mi 'thad/ sangs rgyas kyi thog mar tshogs bsags yul gyi sangs rgyas med pa mi khyud pa'i pyid de skad du mdo sne rgyan las/ tha dad rigs don med phyir dang / /rdzogs dang thog ma med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min zhes gsungs pa'i phyis de semags spro shes sla'o/ /446
sprul sku/smras pa/rgyan dang rin chen yod do cog gi 'od/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin rgyu skar bkram bzhin mang / /dpal dang 'byor bas sgyug po'i pho brang mchog /nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs tshul 'di ngo mtshad /ngo mtshar che mang 'di na sangs rgyas kun/ /dus bzhir 'dus pa'i pha mtha' nam mkha'i mthad /song ba gzigs pa 'i yul min sa bcu yi/ /rgyal sras lubor gyi pha mtha' ci la yod/ /de lta'i phun tshogs gshor la bka' stsal mod/ /sa bcu sdong bkod mdo sogs rgyal sras kyi/ /yul 'di sgra tsam thos tshe 'og min sgya/ /pho brang gzhal yas khang du phyin nam snyam/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku ni/ rtsabad gang gis srid pa ji srid par/ /nas/ thub pa'i sprul sku spyi/ ༷zlo rnyi r+nghi/ tha/༷dī /ji /dpa (lha ༵ traṃ pa na/ ṭ+wāṃ/ lta/ snro pa~X ༵ r+sha )pa ṭ+wāṃ na(lhapa zloshā m+p+raṃ gis gshor ba ji srid par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can rnamasakyi 'dod pa'i don mnyam pa nyid du mdzad pa'i sku de zhes pa nas/ rgyun mi 'chad pa yin zhes byung / 'dir gsum gyi dang 4/ mdo las/ rab 'byor gzhan yang yum 'di la slob pa ni zhes pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag med mtha' med par dus thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pas sprul ba sna tshogs kyis sems can thams cad kyi don 447
skabs brgyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/mdzad ces sogs kyi don 'chad par ga'agrel 'di byung / gnyis pa ni/ shākya thub pa sogs nges pa lnga min gyi sku de chos can/ sprul pa'i sku yin te/ srid mtha'i bar du dag ma dag gi 'phyo ba la dngos su snang nas phan pa sna tshogs mdzad pa'i sku yin pa'i phyisgsum pa mtha' dpyad pa la gsum las/ dang po kha cig na re/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yul nyid du ye shes la sogs pa zhes pa'i ye shes me long ye shes la byas nas sogs khong nas ye shes lhag ma gsum 'don zer na/ 'o na sangs rgyas kho na dang theg chen 'phags pa dang nyan thos sogs gsum la snang tshul ston pa ma yin par thal/ khyod kyis bshad tshul 'thad pa'i nyid 'dod na/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yul nyid du ye shes la sogs pa nas/sku gsum bstan nas zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal lo/ /'dod pa'i pyig khyab ste/ 'dis sangs rgyas nang phan tshun yul du ye shes chos sku bstan/ byang 'phags yul du longs sku bstan/r+ṇa thos dang so skye las dag yan chad don du mchog gi sprul sku bstan pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ sangs rgyas kyi yul du ye shes chos skur btags so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ gser 'phreng las mchog tu dag pa'i 'gro ba 'ba' zhig la mtshan dpe rang mtshan par snang ba'i gzugs sku la stos nas longs sku dang zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ dag pa'i 'gro ba 'ba' zhig ces pas byang 'phags kho nar bshad pa'i phyigrtags gsum pa grub ste/ gser 'phreng las/ dag ma dag gnyis spu'i gdul bya la mtshan dpe'i gzugs can du snang ba'i gzugs sku la ltos nas sprul skur btags so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phar pyin mnga' bdag byang ye na re/ ye shes la sogs pa la ltos nas zhes pa'i don ye shes de chos sku dang sogs khong nas longs sku'i snang ba sprul sku'i snang ba gnyis bskyed pa'i nus pa gnyis la bh+yor zer na/ de slob dpon gyi lugs ma yin par thal/ ye shes de ye shes 448
sprul sku/chos sku bskyed pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs gang zhig /sogs khong nas longs sku'i mtshan dpe bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs dngasga mchog gi sprul sku bskyed pa'i tsogs gnyis kyi cha dag la lus mdor bstan gyi 'grel chen las gsungs pa'i phyig rtags dang po grub ste/ de'i thad kyi rgyan snang las/ rnal 'byor pa'i kun rdzob tu don khyad par can snang ba bskyed pa'i zhes pa nas/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnam nyid kyi rgyud yul du gyur pa ye shes kyi tshogs las byung ba ni chos kyi sku zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam bshad las kyang sangs rgyas kho na'i mdon sum gyi sgyod yul du gyur pa'i yi shes chos kyi sku rang rgyu ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa la lhos nas byung ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ 'grel chen las/ mchog tu dga' ba zhes pa nas/ gzhal du med pa'i brtsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa mtshan dpes rnam par mdzes pa'i sku ni longs rgyud rdzogs pa'i sku yin zhes gsungs pa'i pyisrnam bshad las kyang / byang 'phags yan chad kyi zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rtags gsum pa grub ste/ 'grel chen las/ brtsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi cha las byung ba byis pa dang nyan thos de ba shākya thub pa la sogs pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam bshad las/ mchog gi sprul sku ni tshogs gnyis spu'i cha bsags pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang byang ye shes na re/ snga ma bkag nas ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig dang sogs khong nas longs sprul bstan par 'chad pa'ang shin tu mi 'thad par thal/ yi shes kyi tshogs dang sogs khong nas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / tshogs gnyis lnga'i cha shas dang gsum la rim bzhin stos nas sku gsum byung bar bshad dgos pa'i phyig der thal/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi lag rjes gtso bor chos sku byung/bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi lag rjes gtso sar longs sku'i mtshan dpe dang longs yul pho brang 'phyor ba rnams 'byung] longs sku'i ye shes kyi cha las mchog sprul gyi thugs dang bsod nams 449
skabs brgyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/kyi cha las mchog sprul gyi mtshan dpe sogs 'byung ba'i phyis rtags dang 4 grub ste/ rin chen ༵༵dī pa~X /phyinas n+dha snro shā rnyiX dī swārnyi na//ri/shā dh+ri sna hūm̐ sbyo dī (pas ༵༵ ༷shā lha/ma/ṭā ༵ gzugs sku dang / /bsesnad nams tshogs las byung ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs gcig gi steng gi tshogs gnyis kyi cha gcig gis zhing bye ba phrag brgya'i gzugs sku pye ba phrag brgya sesnags sprul sku mtha' yas pa gcig car du brten nas gnas pa'i phyis rig pa drug cu pa las/ ba〈snad nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob ces dang / rgyud bla dar ṭika las/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid gzugs sku bye ba phrag brgya la sogs pa mtha' yas pa la du cig car du brten nas gnas par shes par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dis sprul sku sangs rgyas min pa dang / thugs med zer ba dag khegs dren/ /yang kha cig na re/ mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kho nar nges zer na/ 'o na mchog gi sprul sku'i sprul pa'i grangs dang mdzad pa'i grangs 'dzin thub par thal/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kho nar nges pa de'i phyig gdod mi nus te/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa grangs med pas phyogs thams cad khyab par byas nas :snas kyi char chen po 'be+ebs pa'i mig dbu ma snying 4 las/ gdul bya ji bzhin sprul pa yis/ /sprul pa yis ni phyogs bkang nas/ /bstan pa rin chen char phab pas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba skyed/ /ces gsungs pa'i sgyid khyab lte/gdul bya'i grangs ltar sprul pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thar pa bskyed pa'i phyir te/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gdul bya gang dang nga la sprul pa gang gis yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'i nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang brgya byin dang/ tshangs pa dang sngag rten skyong ba dang dbang phyug chen po 450
sprul sku/dang sred med kyi bu la sesnags pa'i sprul padedag gis phyogs thams cad khyab par byasanas zhes gsungs pa'i nyid gzhan yang/ dus gsum tshad med pa'i lus byin gyis brlabs te long bas mig thob pa dang 'on pas rna ba thob pa sogs med par thal/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kho nar nges pa'i phyis 'dod na/ mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar dbang po lnga sogs thob pa dang / ma dag pa'i zhing dag pa'i zhing du byin gyis brlabs pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ dbu ma snying 4 las/ dus gsum tshad med 'dus nyid dang / /sangs rgyas zhing ni phun sum tshogs/ /zhes dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las/ 'das pa dang da ltar gyi dus rnams su dpag tu med pa'i lus byin gyis slob par byed/yongs su ma dag pa'i zhing dag par byin gyis rlob par byed do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir / khyab lte/ der ma zad rang lus sangs rgyas zhing du byed/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rang lus su bsgyur ba sogs byed pa'i phyig zub pa'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang grangs tsam la don du mdzad pa bcu gnyis byas te/ de yang longs skus sprul tshul/ rgyud bla ma las/ zugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /zhes gsungs pa dar ṭika las bshad/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i gshor gyis rol ba dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang chub snying sor bshegs pa dang / /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi gshor lo dang / /mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs la/sod kyi paṇa chen rigs ral na re/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba dang por byed zeg de la mkhas pa rgyang rong pa sogs dga' ldan na gnas pa byed dgos zer/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba thog ma 451
skabs brgyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/byas pa gtan nas mi 'thad pa ma yin par thal/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med kyis 'grel chen las bshad pa'i phyig der thal/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa rnams/ /gshegs dang bltams dang rol ba dang / /zhes dga' ldan nas gshegs pa thog mar bshad/ thogs med 'grel chen las/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sprul pa'i skus dang po dga' ldan gyi gnas nas babs pa zhes pa nas/ tha ma yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'i bar gyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis cig car ston zhes dang / dar ṭika las/ de nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi dang po dga' ldan gnas nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'pho ba dang] gnyis pa yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa dang zhes gsungs pa'i phyid des na dga' ldan nas 'pho ba gtso bor 'odzin pa klu sgrub la brten par snang / yar dga' ldan na gnas pa dang por byed pa yang shin tu mang ste/ thogs med dang dbyig gnyen dang legs ldan dang seng bzang rnams kyis bshad pa'i rnyiswā〉 dī k+ṣiṃ/ /pa /lhagam k+ṣiṃ / /sna rnyiswā hūm̐ hā/ji spyan lha pa/ rnyi ṭ+wāṃ bsnyi /pa rnyi / ṭ+wāṃ smra( rten gyi 'gyor ba thams cad sprin las byung ba ltas dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa ston pa'i sgos sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba rnams de la rag las pa'i phyir ro zhes dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las kyang / rtsaba'i de bzhin bstonags pa'i sku las dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sesnags pa nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar gyi sems can la phan pa'i thabs su 'jug pa yin te zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'grel pa don gsal las kyang / dga' ldan gyi gnas nas bzhugs pa la sesnags pa kun tu ston par rung ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyig dga' ldan na gnas pa dang / dga' ldan nas 'pho ba gnyis gang rung mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi thog ma byas pas mi chog par thal/ dga' ldan na gnas pa thog mar byed na lhums zhugs dang bltams 452

sprul sku/bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar yang byang sems bar do na gnas pas gsal bar byed do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir te/ mdzod 'grel las kyang] byang chub sems dpa' ni nas/ de nyid kyi phyir srid par bar ma la gnas pa yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar snang bar mdzad do zhes dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya la skar ma rgyal gyi dus su yum gso bh+yong blangs pa'i rum du dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa nas 'phos te nas/ ma'i slo g.yas pa nas zhugs so zhes gsungs pa'i phyig tsartags gnyis pa zhing khams rgya mtshor mngal 'jug rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i grangs ldan bstan par grub ste/ mdo phal chen las/ de bzhin gshegs pas phyogs bcu'i 'dzig rten gyi khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho thams cad du 'dzig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re re dang nas/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'chi 'pho ba dang / lhums su 'jug pa dang zhes gsungs pa'i pyid lhums su zhugs te yum gyi lhums na rin po che'i khang pa'i nang phyi gsal nang gsal gyi tshul du zla ba bcu'i bar du bzhugs pa yin te/ rgya cher rol pa las lha dang bcas pa'i lajig rten na de'i dbyibs dang kha dog m+wa ba gang yang med do/ /nas/ gser bzhin du khang pa brtsegs pa de rnam par mdzes so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang de nyid las/byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa de lan lta lte/ dper na me long gi dkyil dngor dag pa la gdong gi dkyil dngor snang ba bzhin te zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggsum pa sku bltams pa bye ba phrag brgya cig car bstan pa yin te/ zil gnon me rta'i 〈sna sa ga'i nya la lhums su zhugs shang chu stod zla ba zugal dang bcas pa'i zla ba bcu rdzogs pa'idagun zla cha thung mchu'i zla ba'i nya dang skar ma rgyal gyi snga dro sku bltams pa'i tshe tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis kyis lha'i gos ka shi da'i steng du gdan drangs pas sangs rgyas khang brtsegs kyi nang na khri la bzhugs pade la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnga yab sogs kyi mchod rdzasadag byung ba'i phyir te/463
skabs brgyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/'dul ba rnam 'byed las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byang sems zla ba bcu 'das nas yum gyi lhums nas bltams pa de'i tshe zhes dang/ 'dus pa tog las/ nga ni sa la mngal du zla bcu gnas pa de nas zhesadang] mngon byang gi mdo las/ yum la gzigs pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bcu ru 'dzin nus zhes dang] mdo las/ de zla ba bcu tshang nas ma'i slo g.yas pa nas dran shes bzhin du mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par blangs te zhes dang/ de'i tshe lha dbang brgya byin dang mi mjed gyi tshangs pa gnyis mdun na pa'od de nas/ byang chub sems dpa' blangs so zhes gsungs pa'i phyis der ma zad/ gzhan yang mdo las/ byang sems khang pa brtsegs pa gang gi nang du 'dug cing zhes dang/ klu'i rgyal 4 dga' ṭo dang nyer dga' gnyis kyis nas/ byang sems kyi lus bkrus so/ /brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'dzig rten skyong ba la sogs pa lha'i bu brgya stong mang podag byang sems btsas ma thag tu spos chu sna tshogs dang me tog sil mas lus 'khra zhing mngon par 'thor ro/ /bar snang las kyang rdul g.yab kyi rnga ma gnyis dang rin po che'i gdugs byung bar gyur to zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas btsas dus rgyal po'i skyed tshal du ltas sum cu rtsaganyis byung zhing / bltams nas sus bltan pa med par phyogs bzhir bosnam pa bdun bdun bor nas seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa yin te/ dge mthams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o zhes shar du gom pa bdun 'or bas gom pa bor ba de dang der pad ma bdun bdun skyes/ lha mi'i sbyin gnas su 'gyur bar bya zhes lhor gom pa bdun 'og nub tu gom pa sar bdun par gnas te/ nga ni lajig rten na phul tu phyin pa'o/ /'di ni nga'i skye rga na 'chi'i tha mar dbyung ngo zhes tshem pas seng ge'i sgra bsgrags sesna/ /sems can thams cad kyi nang na bla na med par bya'o zhes byang phyogs logs su gom pa bdun bor ro/ /bdud dang bdud kyi sde gzhom par bya'o zhes byang phyogs logs su gom ba bdun sor ro/ /seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa yin te/ mdo phal chen las/464
sprul sku/bltams pa dngaka brgya byin dang tshangs pas blangs pa dang / gnas bkod pa dang/ gom pa bdun 'dor ba dang/ phyogs bcur rnam par gzigs pa dang / seng ge'i sgra chen 4 slog pa dang / zhes dang / mdo las/ sus kyang bstan pa med par zhes pa nas/ bdud dang bdud kyi sde gzhom par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbzhi pa bzo gnas sogs la sbyangs pa'i tshul bstan tshul yod de/ 'jig rten pa'i bstan bcos gang yod dang grangs dang yig rigs drug cu rtsabazhi dang / nis dang sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsabzhi dang / 'jig rten pa'i bzo sogs thams cad ma bslab par mkhyen cing byis pa stong zag bcu sogs smin pa'i ched du sbyangs pa'i phyig mdo las/ mi yi 'jig rten 'di na bstan bcos gang yod dang / grangs dang yi ge rtsis dang khams kyi rgyud dag dngad /'dzig rten bzo yi spyor ba tshad med mang 4 dag /skal pa bye mang gron chad 'des ni de dag bslabs/ /zhes dang / phal po hūm̐ dh+ri ༵ /kulha rnyi ( dī / daXzo sna/ lhasna ༷ da~X'i / /lha ny+pha ga shālha (lhapa /r+sha sbyispri ༵ dīr+sha / snashā / rgya cher rol pa las/ kye mkhan 'os bdag la yi ge gang bslabs/ tshangs pa'i yi ge'am/ kha rolha'i yi ge'am/ pad ma'i snying po yi ge'am/ aṅga'i yi ge'am/ baṅga'i yi ge'am/ yul ma ga dha'i yi ge'am/ bkra shis pa'i yi ge'am/ thegar resna ba'i yi ge'am/ sha ka na'i yi ge'am/ ya ba na'i yi ge'am/ hu na'i yi ge'am/ yi ge 'bring ngam/ rgyas par dri n+da yi ge'am/ rgyal gyi yige'am/ lha'i yi ge'am/ klu'i yi ge'am/ gnod sbyin gyi yi ge'am/ dri za'i yi ge'am/ mi'am ci'i yi ge'am/ sto 'phye chen po'i yi ge'am/ lha ma yin gyi yi ge'am/ nam mkha' lding gi yi ge'am/ri dwags kyi 'khor lo'i yi ge'am/ khya skad shes pa'i yi ge'am/ sa bla'i lha'i yi ge'am/ bar snang gi lha'i yi ge'am/ nub kyi ba lang bh+yod kyi yi ge'am/ byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi yi ge'am/ shar 465
skabs brgyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/gyi lus 'phags po'i yi ge'am/ bzhag pa'i yi ge'am/ bsnan pa'i yi ge'am/ rgya mtsho'i yi ge'am/ rdo rje'i yi ge'am/ spring yig dang / lan gyi yi ge'am/ rnam mthor gyi yi ge'am/ rings med kyi yi ge'am/ bstan bcos bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ rtsis bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ gdegs pa bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ bzhag pa bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ rkang pas bris pa'i yi ge'am/ tsheg lan gnyis su gdab pa'i tshig gi mtshams kyi yi ge'am/ tshig gi mtshams bcur brgyud pa'i bar ñjashā pa/ sna ma/shā ༵༵ rnyi pasprin paX hūm̐ dzoshādri/ snro za~X lha (3 sngu trī spridasnaX 〉spra rnyisdi/ pa'i yi ge'am/ lha nges pa'i yi ge'am/ sa blta ba'i yi ge'am/ nam mkha' blta ba'i yi ge'am/lho phyogs pa'i yi ge'am/ drag shul can gyi yi ge'am/ grangs kyi yi ge'am/ sgyi'u tshugs pa'i yi ge'am/ rjes su mthun pa'i yi ge'am/ bu sha'i yi ge'am/ ka sha'i yi ge'am/ rgya'i yi ge'am/ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ hūm̐ /rdo/ ṣ+ṭaṃ /sgyu ༷/ nāṃ ༷༷ lci khri shī/sta/ ༷nywa ༷| ñjaṃ two spya /༷ pa ༵ // shā k+ṣiṃ bsnatsho ṭhaṃ r+sha dzār+sha spya ñcha ༈sna hā/ sta//ga/dz+nyo ( hā khri spra/ (3 lhanarmi ༵ brjod pas 'du byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i sgra byung de bzhin du ā brjod pas bdag med pa'i sgra dang / i brjod pas dbang 4 shin tu yangs pa'i dang / ī brjod pas 'gro ba'i yams nad mang ba'i dang / khu brjod pas 'gro ba ni 'tshe ba mang ba'i dang / lū brjod pas 'gro ba ni dpa' 'o dma' ba dang / e brjod pas nyes pa btsal ba las byung ba'i dang / i brjod pas 'phags pa'i lam ni dge'o/ /mo brjod pas chu 'o brgal ba'i dang / au brjod pas rdzu 'phrul 'bul ba'i 466
sprul sku/dang] e brjod pas bdag gi ba mi 'byung ba'i dang / āḥbarjod pas sgrib pa nub pa'i sgra byung ba'i phyig 'dir gsal byed so bzhi yin te/ ka brjod pas las kyi rnam smin la 'jug pa'i phyir dang] kha yi chos kun nam mkha' 'dra ba'i dang / ga yis chos zab pa'i dang / lha yis ma rig gi gti mug gi ming tog sgyug 4 bsal ba'i dang / nga yis yan lag rnam par dag pa'i dang] tsa yis bden pa bzhidang] tsha yis 'dod chags spangs pa'i dang/ dza yi rga shi las 'das pa dang/dzha yis 'chi byed kyi dpung tshar gcad pas dang/ nya yis shes par byed/ ṭa yis lam shin chad pa dang / ṭhi yis dri ba bzhag pa'i dang / ḍa yis dkrug ma dang bdud tshar bcad/ lha yis yul mi gtsang ba dang / ṇa yis nyon mongs ni phra ba zhes pa'i sgra byung ba'i bar bco lnga 'dzid pa'i phyir/lhag ma bcu dgu yodade/ ta yis de nyid ma 'dris pa dang/ tha yis stobs shugs mi 'jigs pa dang / da yis sbyin dang dul dang yang dag sdom dang nges pa'i dang / ha yis 'phags nor bdun dang / na yis ming gzugs shes pa'i dang / ba yis don dam pa'i dang / pha yis 'bras bu rnyed pa mngon du bya ba dang / ba yis bcings pa las rnam par thar pa dang] lha yis srid pa 'dzig pa dang / ma yis nga rgyal dang rgyags pa zhi bar bya ba dang / ya yis chos ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs/ra yis dga' ba la dga' ba med par don dam par dga' ba dang / la yis 'khri shing chad pa dang / wa yis zeg pa mtshog gi dang / sha yis zhi gnas lhag mthong / khu yis skye mched drug gzhol cing mngon shes drug dang ye shes thob pa'i dngan sa yis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i dang/ ha yis nyon mongs bcom zhing gdod chags dang bral ba'i sgra byung / k+ṣa brjod pas yi ge'i mthar phyin te chos thams cad brjod du med pa'i zhes pa'i sgra la sogs pa chos kyi sgo brgya stong grangs med byung bas yi ge'i grwa nas byis pa sum khri nyis stong bla med byang chub thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur pa'i phyir/ sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsabazhi yod de/ phran tshegs 467
skabasabargyad pa skal bzang mig 'byed/— ———————kyi 'grel pa slob dpon tshul khrems bskyangs kyis mdzad pa las/ sgyu rtsal drug cu zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ sgyu rtsal rol mo'i mtshan nyid dang / /sgyu ma'i g.yul dang me tog las/ /sde dpon byam dang bdag nyid can/ /g.yas kyi bya ba zhes bya 'o/ /gang zhig tshong dang khams sma dang / /rgyucha dang lag rtsis bag len dang / lubrul 'khor sbyar dang zhal zhal dngad /'phong spyad dang ni ce spyang skad/ /yi ge dang ni kha skad dang / snyan ngags mtshon gas brtag pa dang / /'khrig thabs dang t+na sog le dang / /so sor dang ni sgo ba dang / /'gro dang 'ong ba shes pa dang / /khyim gyi mtshan nyid dag kyang ngo / /mdung thung rdo rje brtag pa dang / /lter bo dag gi mtshan nyid dang / /zug rngu 'byin dang mi 'phrul gyi/ /bstan bcos pa ta dang zhes bya/ /bcings pa bstan dang sdom pa dang / /de bzhin rdo rje 'phen pa dang / /sha mtshan bcad dang drag pa dang / /chu yi spyong ba nyid dang ni/ /dung skad de bzhin rig byed 'don/ /grong rdal dang ni glegs 'dra dang / mtshan mo tshom rkun shes pa dang / /byis pa rnams ni gagleg ba dang / /mi rnams gnyid ni log byed dang / /sgo lcags 'byed par byed pa/ dang / /mtshon dang gling bu 'bud pa dang / /skyes pa bud med glang po rta/ /mtshan nyid dang ni gar slob dang / /'byung po rnams kyi gso ba 'o/ /zangs dang mkhar ba gser dang ni/ /shing dang dung gi ming shes dang / /ri mo tshon dang so dag ni/ /las rnams de dag 〈snam rim bzhin/ /rgyu skar gtan tshigs rigs pa dang / /ltas dang gsung gi nges tshig nyid/ /shes pa shes bya de dag ni/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsabazhi shes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig byang sems gzhon nu'i sa kun tu ston tshul 〈snad de/ zhang blon sgya bu dag lhan cig zhing mtha' kun tu 〈snang zhing skabs shig nas gcig pur sa'i mtha' zhig tu 'dzam bu brik+ṣa'i 〈snan pa yal ga 〈sna ma phun sum tshogs pa'i grib mar skyil krung gi ba〈snams pas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar ma〈snan du byas te phyi dre'i dus su yang 'dzam bu'i grib mas sku la khyab par gnas pa yab 〈snags mang 468
sprul sku/shos phyag byas shing bstod par mdzad pa'i phyir te/ phal chen las/ sa kun tu ston pa dang zhes sasungs pa'i phyislnga pa btsun mo'i lubor gyis rol tshul yod de/ byang sems gzhon nu las cher skyes pas shākya rgan pa rnams kyis yab rgyal 4 la gzhon nu don grub 'di ltas mkhan dang lha rnams kyis gzhon nu 'di rab tu byung na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhing/ khyim na gnas na lusar los sgyur ba'i rgya la po rgyal srid sna bdun dang ldan par bshad pas/ btsun mo blang bar bya zhes zhus nas shākya lag na be+e rtson gyi bu mo dgos smras/ sgyu rtsal mi shes pa la mi gtong smras so/ /de nas sgyu rtsal 'gran par zhugs pa yin te/ mes po seng ge 'gram gyi gnam ru'am gzhu blangs pas shākya gzhan thams cad kyi brdung ma nus par byang sems des blangs te stan las skyil krung bcas te lag pa ga86na pas blangs nas g.yas pas 〈snar 27 gcig gis brdungs te gzhu sgra byas pas ser skya'i grong khyer thams cad skrag skyog por gyur te/ 'di ci'i sgra dris pas gzhon nu don grub kyi mes po'i gnam ru'i sgra'o 3ra bas/ lha mi brgya stong a la la zer zhing / rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu byang sems kyi 'then lca ga rnga btsugs pa dang / shing ta la bdun sgrig dang / phag rgod kyi gzugs zhakhrul gsor byas pa thams cad phud de mda' gting du zug pa'i shul khron pa'i khung bu byung bar mda'i khron par grags shing/ byang sems kyis sbyangs pa'i sgyu rtsal ni dgu bcu go drug lte/ mdo las/ de bzhin du mtshongs pa dang / yi ge dang / lag rtsis dngad grangs dang] gyad kyi 7)na stangs dang / rgyangs nas phog pa dang / bang dang / tshar dang / skyal dang / 'phang dpyad dang / glang po che'i galtar zhon pa dang / rta rtsal dang / shing rta'i thabs dang / mda' gzhu'i thabs dang / brtan pa dang] mthu dang / dpa' ba dang / 'gyed stobs dang / lcags kyus sgyur thabs dang /zhags pa'i thabs dang / mdun du snur ba dang phyir snu ra ba dang / bzur ba dang / 'odzin ltangs 469
